challenges.name: The Ground is Lava
challenges.text: Win the Mutagen Formula scenario with the Flight modular encounter set, using only heroes who have or can gain the Aerial trait. During this scenario, whenever an identity changes to alter-ego form, deal that identity 2 damage.

challenges.name: Two for One
challenges.text: Defeat a minion and the villain at the same time with the damage dealt by the Fastball Special event.

challenges.name: Magnets and Metal
challenges.text: Defeat the Magneto villain using only heroes from the following list: Iron Man, War Machine, Ironheart, and/or SP//dr. After setup, search the encounter deck for the Seized! side scheme and reveal it.

challenges.name: Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
challenges.text: Defeat the Hood villain using the Acolytes, Dark Riders, Reavers, Blue Moon, Nasty Boys, Brotherhood, and Exodus modular encounter sets.

challenges.name: Form Flippers
challenges.text: Win the En Sabah Nur scenario using any combination of the following heroes: Ant-Man, Wasp, Spectrum, Vision, Shadowcat, and/or Angel.

challenges.name: Flower Power
challenges.text: Defeat the Ronan the Accuser villain as the Groot hero. Groot must be at full health and possess the Power Stone at the end of the scenario.

challenges.name: Breakin' and Takin': Ultimate Edition
challenges.text: Defeat the Rhino villain while including the following modular encounter sets: Infinity Gauntlet, Flight, Super Strength, and Telepathy.

challenges.name: Absorbing the Elements
challenges.text: Defeat the Absorbing Man villain while the following characters are in play (as heroes or allies): Groot, Iceman, Rockslide, and Colossus.

challenges.name: Gene Pool Party
challenges.text: Defeat the Unus villain using only heroes with the ‘Pool aspect, one of whom must be Phoenix.

challenges.name: Need for Speed
challenges.text: Attack the Speed Demon minion three times in one turn with the Quicksilver hero.

challenges.name: Whose Show is it Anyway?
challenges.text: Defeat the Mojo villain as the Spider-Ham and/or Deadpool hero(es). During this scenario, Show environments cannot leave play (ignore their “When Revealed” effects).

challenges.name: Wrath of the Mad Titan
challenges.text: Defeat the Thanos villain using only Avenger and/or Guardian heroes. The final blow can only be dealt by a hero with 1 remaining hit point. After completing setup, advance the main scheme to stage 2A.

challenges.name: Complete the Collection
challenges.text: Win the Infiltrate the Museum scenario as any hero(es). During this scenario, players cannot remove cards from The Collection, and The Grand Collection main scheme no longer causes players to lose when there are 5 per player cards in The Collection.

challenges.name: Symbiote Smackdown
challenges.text:
Defeat the Venom villain with the Venom Nemesis encounter set as the modular encounter set.
Only the Venom hero, Web-Warrior heroes, or heroes with “Spider” in their title can be used. After setup, each player searches their collection for a Symbiote Suit and puts it in play under their control, then searches the encounter deck for an Enraged Symbiote and reveals it.
During this scenario, each Symbiote Suit gains permanent, and each Enraged Symbiote triggers the villain’s Forced Response when attacked.

challenges.name: Fickle Crowds
challenges.text: Defeat MaGog as any hero(es). During this scenario, at the end of each villain phase, move 1 per player ratings counters from The Challengers to The Champion.

challenges.name: Everyday Heroes
challenges.text: Win any scenario as any hero(es) without any identities flipping to hero form (each player must stay in alter-ego form for the entire game).

challenges.name: Mystic Mayhem
challenges.text: Defeat Ebony Maw using the Adam Warlock Nemesis and the Doctor Strange Nemesis encounter sets as modular encounter sets. Only Mystic heroes can be used for this scenario. At the end of each villain phase, first player reveals the top card of the encounter deck.

challenges.name: Lock and Load
challenges.text: Defeat Crossbones using the Osborn Tech, Goblin Gear, and Military Grade modular encounter sets (remove Experimental Weapons). During setup, shuffle four random Weapon cards from these modular sets together to form the Experimental Weapons deck. Shuffle the remaining cards into the encounter deck as normal. For this scenario, only heroes with Weapon or Armor identity-specific upgrades may be used.

challenges.name: Lone Wolf
challenges.text: Defeat Stryfe solo as any hero with no allies in your deck (replace any identity-specific allies with aspect/basic cards). During this scenario, whenever you defeat a minion, draw 1 card.

challenges.name: Field Study
challenges.text: Defeat Dark Beast using the Temporal modular encounter set. Each player must use a hero whose alter-ego has the Genius trait. During this scenario, whenever a minion is revealed, resolve the “Special” ability on the Setting environment.

challenges.name: Battle of the Bots
challenges.text: Defeat Ultron as any hero(es) using the Sentinels modular encounter set. During this scenario, Drone minions gain the Sentinel trait, and Sentinel minions gain the Drone trait.

challenges.name: Not Easy Being Green
challenges.text: Win the Risky Business scenario using only heroes from the following list: She-Hulk, Hulk, Gamora, and/or Drax. Each hero deck must use the Protection aspect for this scenario. During this scenario, if there are ever 6 per player or more infamy counters on Criminal Enterprise, the players lose the game.

challenges.name: The Wreckoning
challenges.text: Win the Wrecking Crew scenario as any hero(es). After setup, search each encounter deck for the following attachments and reveal them: Magic Crowbar, Ball and Chain, Distracting Taunts, and Bulldozer’s Helmet. During this scenario, each villain gains +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each defeated villain.

challenges.name: Absolutely Zero Tolerance
challenges.text: Win the Project Wideawake scenario using the Future Past modular encounter set. Players can only use X-Men heroes for this scenario. After setup, search the encounter deck for Bastion and deal him to the first player as a facedown encounter card. At the end of each villain phase, if Bastion is in the encounter discard pile or victory display, deal him to the first player as a facedown encounter card.

challenges.name: Boss Rush
challenges.text: Defeat the Hela, Taskmaster, and Mister Sinister scenarios, in that order. Players do not reset the game state between each scenario; instead, as soon as one scenario is won, remove all encounter cards from the game (except for Captive allies) and replace them with those of the next scenario, then resume play from the beginning of the player phase. During these scenarios, if any hero is defeated, the players lose the challenge.

aos.name: Zemo's Manipulations
aos.text: Contents: Baron Zemo (A1). (Baron Zemo (B1) instead for expert mode.) Baron Zemo, S.H.I.E.L.D. Executive Board, Executive Board Evidence, and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (Scientist Supreme and S.H.I.E.L.D.). Setup: Prepare the evidence (see rulebook p. 18). Put each [[Board Member]] environment into play. If not playing campaign mode, place 2 secret counters on each [[Board Member]] environment.

aos.name: Zemo's Manipulations
aos.text: Response: After the player phase ends, the first player may place 2 secret counters on a [[Board Member]] environment that has no secret counters on it to gain 2 cards from the S.H.I.E.L.D. envelope (1 card instead in campaign mode). The players may advance to stage 2A to make their accusation. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

aos.name: The Accusation
aos.text: When Revealed: Make an accusation by guessing a means, a motive, and an opportunity, along with the board member associated with that combination in the campaign log. This board member is the accused. (See "The Accusation" on p. 19 of the rulebook.)

aos.name: The Accusation
aos.text: When Revealed: Do the following: 1. Use the cards in the A.I.M. envelope to identify the mole. 2. For each guess you got wrong, place 1 secret counter on each [[Board Member]] card. 3. If you accused the wrong board member, place 3 secret counters on the accused. 4. Advance to stage 3A.

aos.name: Fighting Zemo
aos.text: When Revealed: Flip Baron Zemo to his [[Unmasked]] side and reset his hit points to his printed hit point value. Find Baron Zemo's Sword and attach it to him.

aos.name: Fighting Zemo
aos.text: When Revealed: Flip the mole to its attachment side and attach it to Baron Zemo. Place 1[per_hero] threat here for each secret counter on each [[Board Member]] attachment. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

aos.name: * Baron Zemo's Sword
aos.text: Attach to Baron Zemo. [star] Forced Response: After Baron Zemo attacks and defeats a character, place 1 secret counter on the [[Board Member]] environment with the fewest secret counters. Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] [physical] or [energy] [energy] [energy] resources → remove 1 secret counter from a [[Board Member]] environment and discard this card.

aos.name: Reluctant Foe
aos.text: Treat attached hero as an [[Elite]] minion with SCH equal to its printed THW. Replace its printed text box with: "Villainous. When Defeated: Remove this hero and Reluctant Foe from the game." When Revealed: Search your collection for a hero whose title does not match a character in play and put it into play engaged with you. Attach this card to it.

aos.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent
aos.text: Quickstrike. Vulnerable. [star] Forced Interrupt: When S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent activates or is defeated, add 1 secret counter to the [[Board Member]] environment with the fewest secret counters.

aos.name: Divided Loyalties
aos.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. As an additional cost for a player to attack, thwart, or defend with an ally, that player must spend 1 resource of any type. When Defeated: Remove 1[per_hero] secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

aos.name: Undermine Support
aos.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. As an additional cost for a player to ready a support, that player must spend 1 resource of any type. When Defeated: Remove 1[per_hero] secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

aos.name: Battle of Wits
aos.text: When Revealed: Baron Zemo schemes. If this activation would place any threat on the main scheme, you may spend X [mental] resources to prevent X of that threat and remove X secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

aos.name: Might Makes Right
aos.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Place 2 secret counters on the [[Board Member]] environment with the fewest secret counters. When Revealed (Hero): Baron Zemo attacks you. If no character takes damage from this attack, remove 3 secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments.

aos.name: The Ends Justify the Means
aos.text: When Revealed: Choose: • Baron Zemo defeats the minion with the fewest remaining hit points. Baron Zemo schemes. • Discard an ally or support you control → remove secret counters from among [[Board Member]] environments equal to the discarded card's printed resource cost.

aos.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Trooper
aos.text: Patrol. Vulnerable. When Defeated: The engaged player discards 1 [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] ally or support they control. Otherwise, place 2 threat on the main scheme.

aos.name: Arrest Warrant
aos.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity or 1 [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] card you control → search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] minion and reveal it. (Shuffle.) Discard this card.

aos.name: Disavowed
aos.text: Increase the resource cost to play each [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] card by 1. When Revealed: Place 1 threat here for each [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] card in play.

aos.name: Chief Medical Officer
aos.text: Setup. If there are 4 or more secret counters here (3 or more instead in expert mode), flip this card. Hero Action: Spend [energy] [energy] resources → remove 1 secret counter from here. Then, heal 1 damage from a friendly character.

aos.name: Medical Officer's Aid
aos.text: Attach to the villain. Permanent. Forced Response: After a secret counter is placed here, either heal 2 damage from the villain or deal 1 damage to the friendly character with the fewest remaining hit points. If there are 3 [[Board Member]] attachments in play, the players lose the game.

aos.name: Chief Surveillance Officer
aos.text: Setup. If there are 4 or more secret counters here (3 or more instead in expert mode), flip this card. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources → remove 1 secret counter from here. Then, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

aos.name: Surveillance Officer's Aid
aos.text: Attach to the villain. Permanent. Forced Response: After a secret counter is placed here, place 2 threat on the main scheme. If there are 3 [[Board Member]] attachments in play, the players lose the game.

aos.name: Chief Tactical Officer
aos.text: Setup. If there are 4 or more secret counters here (3 or more instead in expert mode), flip this card. Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] resources → remove 1 secret counter from here. Then, deal 2 damage to an enemy.

aos.name: Tactical Officer's Aid
aos.text: Attach to the villain. Permanent. Forced Response: After a secret counter is placed here, deal 2 damage to a friendly character. If there are 3 [[Board Member]] attachments in play, the players lose the game.

aos.name: A.I.M. Interference ([energy])
aos.text:
Incite 1. When Revealed: Place 1 secret counter on each [[Board Member]] card. You may spend X [energy] resources to prevent X of these counters from being placed.
[star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

aos.name: A.I.M. Interference ([mental])
aos.text:
Incite 1. When Revealed: Place 1 secret counter on each [[Board Member]] card. You may spend X [mental] resources to prevent X of these counters from being placed.
[star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

aos.name: A.I.M. Interference ([physical])
aos.text:
Incite 1. When Revealed: Place 1 secret counter on each [[Board Member]] card. You may spend X [physical] resources to prevent X of these counters from being placed.
[star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

aos.name: Medical Records
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Protection ally and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Protection ally and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

aos.name: Wiretap
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Justice ally and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Justice ally and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

aos.name: Security Scanner
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Aggression ally and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for an Aggression ally and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

aos.name: Money
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Protection upgrade and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Protection upgrade and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

aos.name: Blackmail
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Justice upgrade and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Justice upgrade and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

aos.name: Ideology
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Aggression upgrade and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for an Aggression upgrade and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

aos.name: Security Clearance
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Protection support and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Protection support and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

aos.name: Travel
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Justice support and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for a Justice support and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

aos.name: Authority
aos.text: Setup: Each player may add 1 secret counter to a [[Board Member]] environment to search their collection for a different Aggresion support and shuffle it into their deck. Each player may add 1 threat to the main scheme to search their deck for an Aggresion support and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

bp.name: * Black Panther
bp.text: [star] Response: After Black Panther uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control.

bp.name: * Shuri
bp.text: Inventor — Action: Exhaust Shuri → search your deck for a [[Black Panther]] or [[Tech]] upgrade and play it, reducing its resource cost by 2. (Limit once per round.)

bp.name: * T'Challa
bp.text: [star] Hero Response: After T'Challa uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control.

bp.name: Clawed Strike
bp.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. Resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control.

bp.name: On the Prowl
bp.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control.

bp.name: Wakanda Forever!
bp.text: Hero Action: Resolve the "Special" ability on each [[Black Panther]] upgrade you control in any order.

bp.name: * The Elephant's Trunk
bp.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust The Elephant's Trunk and up to 2 other [[Wakanda]] allies and/or supports you control → draw 1 card for each card exhausted this way (including this one).

bp.name: * Queen Ramonda
bp.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Queen Ramonda → heal damage from an alter-ego with the [[Wakanda]] trait equal to that alter-ego's REC.

bp.name: * Aja-Adanna
bp.text: Action: Exhaust Aja-Adanna → shuffle 1 identity-specific card from your discard pile into your deck.

bp.name: Kimoyo Beads
bp.text: Special (thwart): Remove 1 threat from a scheme. You may discard this card to confuse an enemy.

bp.name: Panther Claws
bp.text: Special (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may discard this card to deal 3 additional damage to that enemy. If you do, this attack gains piercing.

bp.name: Spider Bites
bp.text: Special: Choose a player. Deal 1 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player. You may discard this card to stun each of those enemies.

bp.name: Vibranium Suit
bp.text: Special (attack): Move 1 damage from your hero to an enemy. You may discard this card to give your hero a tough status card.

bp.name: * Manifold
bp.subtitle: Eden Fesi
bp.text: Response: After Manifold enters play, choose a player. That player searches their deck and discard pile for a player side scheme and adds it to their hand.

bp.name: Infiltration
bp.text: Hero Action (thwart): Choose a number from 1 to 5. Discard that many cards from the top of the encounter deck → remote 1 threat from a scheme for each card discarded this way. Put 1 minion discarded this way into play engaged with you.

bp.name: * Going Undercover
bp.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The defeating player looks at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. They may add 1 non-scenario-specific card from among those to the victory display, then place the rest on the top and/or bottom of the encounter deck in any order.

bp.name: * Show of Empathy
bp.text: Victory 0. Forced Interrupt: When threat is removed from this scheme, place that threat on a non-[[Elite]] minion. If that minion has threat on it equal to or greater than its remaining hit points, add Show of Empathy to the victory display and attach 1 set-aside copy of Redemption to that minion.

bp.name: * The Raft
bp.text: Response: After a minion leaves play, tuck it under here from the encounter discard pile → remove threat from a scheme equal to the tucked minion's printed SCH. If there are at least 4 minions here, deal 1 random minion here to any player as a facedown encounter card.

bp.name: Invisibility Gear
bp.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Interrupt: When an enemy would attack you, discard Invisibility Gear → that enemy schemes instead.

bp.name: Sting Operation
bp.text: Max 1 per player. Response: After a non-[[Elite]] minion schemes, discard Sting Operation → discard that minion.

bp.name: * Aneka
bp.text: [star] Response: After Aneka uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on another [[Dora Milaje]] ally. Special: Remove 1 threat from a scheme.

bp.name: * Ayo
bp.text: [star] Response: After Ayo uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on another [[Dora Milaje]] ally. Special: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

bp.name: * Okoye
bp.text: [star] Response: After Okoye uses a basic power, resolve the "Special" ability on another [[Dora Milaje]] ally. Special: Choose a [[Wakanda]] hero or ally. They get +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

bp.name: Heart of the Panther
bp.text: Team-Up (Black Panther/T'Challa and Black Panther/Shuri). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a [[Black Panther]] upgrade and put it into play. Resolve the "Special" ability on up to 4 [[Black Panther]] upgrades you control in any order.

bp.name: * Build Support
bp.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for a support with a cost of 3 or less and put it into play. (Shuffle.)

bp.name: * Dora Milaje
bp.text: Ignore this card's resource cost if your identity has the [[Wakanda]] trait. Action: Exhaust Dora Milaje → resolve the "Special" ability on 1 [[Dora Milaje]] ally and heal 1 damage from that ally.

bp.name: T'Challa's Shadow
bp.text: Give to the Shuri player. Uses (4 doubt counters). Victory 0. Increase the resource cost of each card you play by 1. Forced Response: After you thwart, attack, or defend, remove 1 doubt counter from here.

bp.name: * Klaw
bp.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Klaw attacks, give him 1 boost card for this activation. (Black Panther's nemesis minion.)

bp.name: Manipulated M.U.S.I.C.
bp.text: When Revealed: Find M.U.S.I.C. and put her into play engaged with you. When Defeated: Discard M.U.S.I.C. from play.

bp.name: * M.U.S.I.C.
bp.text: When Revealed: Find Manipulated M.U.S.I.C. and put it into play. When Defeated: Move all threat from Manipulated M.U.S.I.C. to the main scheme.

bp.name: Redemption
bp.text:
Linked (Show of Empathy). Victory 0.
Take control of attached minion and treat it as a [[Redeemed]] ally with a blank text box. Its THW is equal to its printed SCH and it takes 1 consequential damage after it thwarts or attacks.

bp.name: * White Wolf
bp.subtitle: Hunter
bp.text: [star] Forced Response: After White Wolf attacks, place 1 threat on the main scheme.

bp.name: Target Spotter
bp.text: Uses (2 target counters). Interrupt: When a minion would engage a player, remove 1 target counter from here → that minion cannot activate until the end of the phase. Engage that minion.

bp.name: * Joystick
bp.text: Villainous. Victory 1. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Joystick activates against you, choose: • Give her 1 additional boost card for this activation and draw 1 card. • Give her a tough status card.

bp.name: Playing for Keeps
bp.text: Each identity gets +1 hand size. Forced Interrupt: When an enemy activates, give it 1 boost card for that activation (in addition to any other boost cards it gets).

bp.name: Extreme Risk
bp.text:
When Revealed: Find Joystick and reveal her. (If she is already in play, she engages you.) Joystick activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: You may give the activating enemy an additional boost card. If you do, draw 1 card.

silk.name: * Silk
silk.text: If there are more than 4 tucked cards here, discard all but 4 of those cards. Silk Sense — Response: After you defeat a minion or side scheme, or resolve a treachery card, tuck that card under here from the encounter discard pile.

silk.name: * Cindy Moon
silk.text: If there are more than 4 tucked cards here, discard all but 4 of those cards. Action: Discard a card tucked here → draw 2 cards. (Limit once per round.)

silk.name: Smooth as Silk
silk.text: Hero Action: Choose an enemy or scheme in play → discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a card from the same encounter set as the chosen card is discarded. Tuck that discarded card under Silk.

silk.name: Swinging Silk Kick
silk.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy. You may discard a card tucked under Silk from the same encounter set as that enemy. If you do, this attack deals 2 additional damage and gains overkill.

silk.name: Wallcrawl
silk.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. Choose a scheme. You may discard a card tucked under Silk from the same encounter set as the chosen scheme to remove 3 threat from the chosen scheme.

silk.name: * Get the Scoop
silk.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity → remove 2 threat from here. Any player may trigger this ability. When Defeated: The Cindy Moon player looks at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and tucks 1 of those cards under their identity.

silk.name: * Albert Moon
silk.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Albert Moon → choose: • Tuck the top card of the encounter deck under Cindy Moon. • Heal 1 damage from Cindy Moon for each card tucked under her.

silk.name: * J. Jonah Jameson
silk.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card → search your deck and discard pile for Get the Scoop and put it into play. Action: Exhaust this card → remove 2 threat from a side scheme.

silk.name: Eidetic Memory
silk.text: Interrupt: When you reveal a card from the same encounter set as a card tucked under your identity, exhaust Eidetic Memory → swap those cards. Reveal the card that had been tucked under Silk instead.

silk.name: Organic Webbing
silk.text: Silk gets +1 THW. Hero Action: Exhaust Organic Webbing and discard a card tucked under Silk → ready Silk. She gains the [[Aerial]] trait until the end of the round.

silk.name: Outwit
silk.text: Hero Interrupt: When Silk makes a basic thwart, exhaust Outwit → for this thwart she gets +1 THW for each card tucked under her from the same encounter set as the thwarted scheme.

silk.name: Spider Claws
silk.text: Hero Interrupt: When Silk makes a basic attack, exhaust Spider Claws → for this attack she gets +1 ATK for each card tucked under her from the same encounter set as the attacked enemy. This attack gains piercing.

silk.name: Spider Reflexes
silk.text: Hero Interrupt: When Silk defends, exhaust Spider Reflexes → for this attack she gets +1 DEF for each card tucked under her from the same encounter set as the attacking enemy. After this attack, tuck the top card of the encounter discard pile under Silk.

silk.name: * Scarlet Spider
silk.subtitle: Ben Reilly
silk.text: Interrupt: When another [[Web-Warrior]] character would take any amount of damage, Scarlet Spider takes that damage instead.

silk.name: * Spider-Byte
silk.subtitle: Margo Kess
silk.text: Reduce the cost to play Spider-Byte by 1 for each [[Tech]] card you control.

silk.name: "Stop Hitting Yourself"
silk.text: Hero Response (attack): After you defend against an enemy attack and take no damage, deal damage to that enemy equal to your DEF for that attack.

silk.name: * Dr. Sinclair
silk.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Dr. Sinclair and spend a [mental] resource → heal damage from your alter-ego equal to your REC. You may discard 1 status card from your identity. Any player may trigger this ability.

silk.name: Energy Shield
silk.text: Attach to a character. Max 1 per character. Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, spend X [energy] resources → prevent X of that damage.

silk.name: Ready for a Fight
silk.text: Requirement ([physical]). Max 1 per player. Interrupt: When an enemy would scheme, discard Ready for a Fight → change to hero form. That enemy attacks you instead.

silk.name: Stun Gun
silk.text: Restricted. Uses (2 charge counters). Hero Action: Exhaust Stun Gun and remove 1 or 2 charge counters from it → if you removed: • 1 charge counter, stun a minion. • 2 charge counters, stun the villain.

silk.name: * Madame Web
silk.subtitle: Julia Carpenter
silk.text: Response: After Madame Web enters play, look at the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is the number of [[Web-Warrior]] cards you control. You may discard 1 card looked at this way and put the rest back in any order.

silk.name: Investigative Journalism
silk.text: Team-Up (Cindy Moon and Peter Parker). Max 1 per deck. Alter-Ego Interrupt: When an enemy would scheme, cancel that activation and confuse that enemy.

silk.name: Silk Sense Overload
silk.text: Give to the Cindy Moon player. Forced Interrupt: When a card would be tucked under your identity by a player card effect, tuck it under here instead. Then, if there are 2 tucked cards here, you may discard this card (remove it from the game instead if there are 3 or more tucked cards here).

silk.name: * Morlun
silk.text: [star] Morlun gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each encounter card tucked under each identity. When Defeated: Discard each copy of Hunting the Spider-Bride tucked under each identity.

silk.name: The Great Hunt
silk.text: When Revealed: Place 1 additional threat here for each card tucked under each identity.

silk.name: Hunting the Spider-Bride
silk.text: Surge. When Revealed: If you have 4 cards tucked under your identity, discard 1 of those cards at random. Tuck this card under your identity. Forced Response: After a player card effect discards this card from under an identity, that identity takes 2 damage.

silk.name: * Spider-Man 2099
silk.subtitle: Miguel O'Hara
silk.text: [star] Response: After Spider-Man 2099 uses a basic power, return a [[Web-Warrior]] ally in play to its owner's hand.

silk.name: * Spider-Woman
silk.subtitle: Jessica Drew
silk.text: Response: After a [[Web-Warrior]] ally (including this one) enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

silk.name: Quick Quip
silk.text: Requirement ([mental]). Hero Action: Deal 1 damage to a [[Web-Warrior]] character you control → place a total of 2 confused status cards on up to 2 enemies.

silk.name: * Atlas
silk.text: Villainous. Victory 1. [star] Atlas gets +2 hit points for each growth counter on him. Forced Response: After the villain phase ends, place 1 growth counter on Atlas.

silk.name: Grow Invulnerable
silk.text: When Revealed: Place 1 additional threat here for each growth counter on Atlas. If Atlas has 10 or more growth counters on him, the players lose the game.

silk.name: Growing Strong
silk.text:
When Revealed: Find Atlas and reveal him. (If he is already in play, he engages you.) Atlas activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Give the activating enemy a tough status card.

falcon.name: * Falcon
falcon.text: During the player phase, play with the top card of the encounter deck faceup. Eagle-Eyed — Response: After you play an [[Aerial]] card, discard the top card of the encounter deck.

falcon.name: * Sam Wilson
falcon.text: Birds of a Feather — Action: Discard 1 card from your hand → search your deck and discard pile for a [[Bird]] card and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)

falcon.name: * Redwing
falcon.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Redwing, return him to your hand, and discard the top card of the encounter deck → choose to either deal X damage to an enemy or remove X threat from a scheme. X is the number of icons ([star] and [boost]) in the discarded card's boost area.

falcon.name: Bird of Prey
falcon.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. You may discard the top card of the encounter deck to deal 1 additional damage to that enemy for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in the discarded card's boost area.

falcon.name: Bird's-Eye View
falcon.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. You may discard the top card of the encounter deck to remove 1 additional threat from that scheme for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in the discarded card's boost area.

falcon.name: Up, Up, and Away
falcon.text: Hero Response (defense): After an attacking enemy is given a facedown boost card, look at that card and the top card of the encounter deck. You may swap those cards. Draw 1 card for each printed icon ([star] and [boost]) in the (current) boost card's boost area.

falcon.name: Falcon's Flock
falcon.text: Uses (5 bird counters). Resource: Remove 1 bird counter from here → generate a [energy] resource for an [[Aerial]] card. (Limit once per card.)

falcon.name: Soup Kitchen
falcon.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Sam Wilson and Soup Kitchen → heal damage from Sam Wilson equal to his REC and reduce the cost of the next ally or support played this phase by 2.

falcon.name: Aerial Evacuation
falcon.text: Hero Interrupt: When another friendly character would be dealt any amount of damage, discard Aerial Evacuation → prevent all of that damage and change to alter-ego form. If that character is a hero, they also change to alter-ego form.

falcon.name: Aerial Recon
falcon.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Aerial Recon and deal a player 1 facedown encounter card → place 1 recon counter here. Interrupt: When a player would be dealt an encounter card, remove 1 recon counter from here instead.

falcon.name: Battlefield Awareness
falcon.text: Hero Interrupt: When Falcon uses a basic power, exhaust Battlefield Awareness and discard the top card of the encounter deck → Falcon gets +1 to that power for this use for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in the discarded card's boost area.

falcon.name: Draw Their Fire
falcon.text: Hero Response: After the villain phase begins, discard Draw Their Fire → Falcon does not exhaust to defend until the end of the phase.

falcon.name: Talon Line
falcon.text: Hero Response: After you resolve Falcon's "Eagle-Eyed" ability, discard Talon Line → for each icon in the discarded card's boost area, choose 1: • Ready a character you control. • Stun an enemy.

falcon.name: Vibranium Microweave
falcon.text: Falcon gets +1 DEF. Hero Interrupt: When Falcon would take any amount of damage, exhaust Vibranium Microweave → prevent 1 of that damage and deal 1 damage to an enemy.

falcon.name: * Aero
falcon.subtitle: Lei Ling
falcon.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Aero → choose a player. Until the end of the phase, each [[Aerial]] character that player controls gets +1 ATK.

falcon.name: * Hugin & Munin
falcon.text: Response: After Hugin & Munin enter play, search the top 10 cards of the encounter deck for a minion and put it into play engaged with you → ready 1 character you control for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in that minion's boost area.

falcon.name: * Spectrum
falcon.subtitle: Monica Rambeau
falcon.text: Response: After you play Spectrum, tuck 1 card used to pay for her under her. If that card's printed resource has: [mental] – Spectrum gets +2 THW. [physical] – Spectrum gets +2 ATK. [energy] – Spectrum gets +2 hit points. [wild] – All of the above.

falcon.name: Strength in Diversity
falcon.text: Alliance. Hero Action: For each different [[Trait]] on friendly characters in play, choose: • Remove 1 threat from a scheme. • Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

falcon.name: Flight Squadron

When Revealed: Choose: • Exhaust a [[Daily Bugle]] support (under any player's control) and remove 1 stamina counter from it. • Place 2 threat on the main scheme.
[star] Boost: Exhaust a [[Daily Bugle]] support (under any player's control).

fne.name: * Kingpin
fne.text: Stalwart. Kingpin cannot be dealt damage or have upgrades attached. (The players must garner Public Support to face him directly.) [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin would attack you, he schemes instead.

fne.name: * Kingpin
fne.text: Steady. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin activates against you, if you are not engaged with a minion, give Kingpin 1 additional boost card for this activation.

fne.name: * Kingpin
fne.text: Stalwart. Kingpin cannot be dealt damage or have upgrades attached. (The players must garner Public Support to face him directly.) [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin would attack you, he schemes instead.

fne.name: * Kingpin
fne.text: Steady. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin activates against you, if you are not engaged with a minion, give Kingpin 1 additional boost card for this activation and this activation gains overkill if it is an attack.

fne.name: The King's Gambit
fne.text: Contents: Kingpin (A1) (Kingpin (B1) instead for expert mode.) Kingpin encounter set. Two modular encounter sets (Tombstone and Tracksuit Mafia). Setup: Each player reveals their set-aside nemesis minion. Each player whose nemesis minion shares a title with a character in play instead removes their nemesis minion from the game, then finds an [[Underling]] minion that is not in play and reveals it.

fne.name: The King's Gambit
fne.text: When Revealed: Put Public Support into play, LOW side faceup. Hero Action: Remove 5 threat from here (4 threat instead in expert mode). Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck, then discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded and reveal that minion. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

fne.name: Endgame
fne.text: When Revealed: Each player finds their nemesis minion and reveals it. Each player whose nemesis minion did not enter play this way finds an [[Underling]] minion that is not in play and reveals it. In expert mode, the first player finds and reveals the Organized Crime side scheme.

fne.name: Endgame
fne.text:
Each minion gains guard.
If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

fne.name: Public Support
fne.subtitle: LOW
fne.text: Forced Response: After a minion is defeated, place 1 support counter here. Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, if there are at least 2[per_hero]+2 support counters here, flip Kingpin and advance the main scheme to stage 2A. Then, flip this card.

fne.name: Public Support
fne.subtitle: HIGH
fne.text: Interrupt: When an enemy would be given a facedown boost card, remove 1[per_hero] support counters from here instead. Forced Response: After a minion is defeated, place 1 support counter here.

fne.name: Bear Hug
fne.text: If Kingpin has the [[Martial Artist]] trait, attach to your hero. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Uses (3 grip counters). You cannot change to alter-ego form. Forced Interrupt: When you would thwart or attack, remove 1 grip counter from here instead.

fne.name: * James Wesley
fne.text:
When Revealed: Attach to Kingpin and give him a facedown boost card. Hero Action: Discard a [[Thwart]] event from your hand → discard James Wesley. Kingpin schemes.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Kingpin.

fne.name: * Kingpin's Cane
fne.text:
When Revealed: Attach to Kingpin. You are stunned. Forced Response: After Kingpin attacks and damages a hero, stun that hero. If a hero is stunned this way, discard this card.
[star] Boost: You are stunned. If you were already stunned, take 1 damage.

fne.name: Mountain of Muscle
fne.text: If Kingpin has the [[Martial Artist]] trait, attach to Kingpin. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Kingpin gains retaliate 1. Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. Then, if there is 8 or more damage here, discard this card.

fne.name: * Vanessa Fisk
fne.text:
When Revealed: Attach to Kingpin. You are confused. Hero Action: Discard an [[Attack]] event from your hand → discard Vanessa Fisk. Kingpin attacks you.
[star] Boost: You are confused. If you were already confused, place 1 threat on the main scheme.

fne.name: * Black Cat
fne.text: Villainous. While there is 4 threat here, treat Black Cat as an ally that takes 2 consequential damage after she attacks or thwarts. Hero Action: Spend a [mental] resource → place 1 threat here. If there is 4 threat here, take control of Black Cat as an ally.

fne.name: * Diamondback
fne.text:
Villainous. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Diamondback attacks you, take 1 damage.
[star] Boost: Take 1 damage.

fne.name: * Spot
fne.text: Enters play with 1 spot counter on him. Forced Interrupt: When Spot would be dealt damage from an attack, if there is at least 1 spot counter here, remove 1 spot counter from here and deal that damage to the attacker instead. Otherwise, place 1 spot counter here.

fne.name: * Stilt-Man
fne.text: Enters play with 2 stilt counters on him. [star] Stilt-Man gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each stilt counter on him. Forced Interrupt: When Stilt-Man would take any amount of damage, remove 1 stilt counter from him instead.

fne.name: Kingpin's Influence
fne.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme places 3 threat on their nemesis side scheme. If it is not in play, they find it and reveal it.

fne.name: Organized Crime
fne.text: Each minion gets +2 hit points.

fne.name: Bag of Tricks
fne.text:
When Revealed: Reveal a random card from your set-aside nemesis set. If no card is revealed this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Give this character a random card from your set-aside nemesis set as an additional boost card.

fne.name: Unrelenting Hate
fne.text:
When Revealed: Your nemesis minion activates against you. If your nemesis minion is not in play, find it and reveal it. If you cannot find it, find an [[Underling]] minion that is not in play and reveal it.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains overkill.

fne.name: Mystic Incursion
fne.text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted a [[Mystic]] character).

fne.name: Sinking Ferry
fne.text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [energy] [energy] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted an [[Aerial]] character).

fne.name: Towering Inferno
fne.text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted a character that has a tough status card).

fne.name: Collapsing Bridge
fne.text: [star] Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After any amount of threat is removed from Collapsing Bridge, place 1 threat here.

fne.name: Bystanders in Peril
fne.text:
Peril. When Revealed: Place 1 civilian counter on a [[Disaster]] environment. If no counter was placed this way, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Disaster]] environment and reveal it.
[star] Boost: Place 1 civilian counter on a [[Disaster]] environment.

fne.name: Cop
fne.text: Quickstrike. Vulnerable. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Cop would scheme, it attacks the villain instead. When Defeated: Place 2 threat on the main scheme.

fne.name: Crooked Cop
fne.text:
Quickstrike. Vulnerable. When Defeated: The defeating player deals themself 1 facedown encounter card.
[star] Boost: Take 2 indirect damage.

fne.name: Wanted
fne.text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[Police]] minion is discarded and put it into play engaged with you. Discard this card.

fne.name: Police Cordon
fne.text: [star] Hinder 1[per_hero]. Each [[Police]] minion gains guard and patrol. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Police]] minion and reveal it.

fne.name: Sports Car
fne.text: Attach to the enemy with the highest ATK without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 4 or more damage here, discard this card.

fne.name: Motorcycle
fne.text: Attach to the enemy with the highest SCH without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 3 or more damage here, discard this card.

fne.name: Utility Van
fne.text: Attach to the enemy with the fewest remaining hit points without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 6 or more damage here, discard this card.

fne.name: Traffic Jam
fne.text: [star] Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Interrupt: When a character with a [[Vehicle]] attachment would: • Add threat to a scheme, that threat is added here instead. • Remove threat from a scheme, that threat is removed from here instead.

fne.name: Carjacking
fne.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[Vehicle]] attachment is discarded and reveal it. If your identity does not have a [[Vehicle]] attachment, you may spend 3 resources of the same type to attach the discarded attachment to your identity instead.

fne.name: Flight Serum
fne.text: Attach to a non-[[Aerial]] enemy. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached enemy gains [[Aerial]]. Hero Action: Discard an [[Attack]] event from your hand → discard this card.

fne.name: * Mister Fish
fne.text: [star] Mister Fish's attacks gain piercing and ranged. When Revealed: Mister Fish engages the player whose identity has the fewest remaining hit points.

fne.name: * The Owl
fne.text:
Quickstrike. [star] The Owl's attacks gain piercing.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains piercing.

fne.name: Swoop Down
fne.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The villain and each minion engaged with you schemes. Each [[Aerial]] enemy gets +2 SCH for its activation. When Revealed (Hero): The villain and each minion engaged with you attacks you. Each [[Aerial]] enemy gets +2 ATK for its activation.

fne.name: Cold as Ice
fne.text: Attach to the minion with the highest base hit points and give that minion a tough status card. Otherwise, this card gains surge. [star] Forced Response: After attached minion schemes, confuse the first player's identity and discard Cold as Ice.

fne.name: Hard as Marble
fne.text: Attach to the minion with the highest base hit points and give that minion a tough status card. Otherwise, this card gains surge. [star] Forced Response: After attached minion attacks, stun the attacked character and discard Hard as Marble.

fne.name: * Beetle
fne.text: Villainous. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an attachment that can attach to a minion and attach it to Beetle.

fne.name: * Tombstone
fne.text:
Quickstrike.
[star] Boost: Give the villain a tough status card.

fne.name: Hit List
fne.text: Forced Response: After the villain phase begins, deal 3 indirect damage to the first player. For each ally defeated this way, remove 1[per_hero] threat from Hit List.

fne.name: * Ivan Banionis
fne.text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). When Revealed: Place 1 acceleration token here. [star] Forced Response: After Ivan Banionis schemes, place 1 acceleration token here.

fne.name: * The Clown
fne.text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After The Clown schemes, give him 1 facedown boost card.

fne.name: * Tracksuit Mafioso
fne.text: Retaliate 2. Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Vulnerable. When Defeated: Tuck this card under the Tracksuit Mafia side scheme. Otherwise, stun and confuse the character that defeated Tracksuit Mafioso.

fne.name: Tracksuit Bro
fne.text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Vulnerable. When Defeated: Tuck this card under the Tracksuit Mafia side scheme. Otherwise, shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

fne.name: Tracksuit Mafia
fne.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Tracksuit]] minion is discarded and tuck that minion here. Forced Response: After a player reveals a [[Tracksuit]] minion from the encounter deck, that player reveals 1 minion tucked here.

fne.name: Art Museum Heist
fne.subtitle: Completed
fne.text: Setup: Give each identity a tough status card.

fne.name: Art Museum Heist
fne.subtitle: Failed
fne.text: Setup: Each player chooses to stun or confuse their identity (in expert mode, do both instead).

fne.name: The Getaway
fne.subtitle: Completed
fne.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for an upgrade and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.

fne.name: The Getaway
fne.subtitle: Failed
fne.text: In expert mode, attachments cannot be discarded from play during the first round. Setup: Each player searches the encounter deck for an attachment and reveals it. Deal a facedown encounter card to each player who could not.

fne.name: Protection Racket
fne.subtitle: Completed
fne.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for a support and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.

fne.name: Protection Racket
fne.subtitle: Failed
fne.text: Setup: Each player chooses and discards 1 card from their hand (in expert mode, 2 cards instead).

fne.name: The Raft Breakout
fne.subtitle: Completed
fne.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for an ally and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.

fne.name: The Raft Breakout
fne.subtitle: Failed
fne.text: Setup: Shuffle each minion in The Raft Breakout encounter set into the encounter deck (in expert mode, deal 1 of those minions at random to each player as a facedown encounter card before shuffling in the rest).

fne.name: Stop the Presses!
fne.subtitle: Completed
fne.text: Setup: Each player puts 1 [[Daily Bugle]] support (that has not been removed from the campaign) into play from the Stop the Presses! encounter set.

fne.name: Stop the Presses!
fne.subtitle: Failed
fne.text: Setup: Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card (in expert mode, 2 encounter cards instead).

fne.name: * Typhoid Mary
fne.subtitle: Mary Walker
fne.text: Setup. Victory -1. [star] Forced Response: After you reveal a minion, remove all damage from here and flip this card.

fne.name: * Bloody Mary
fne.subtitle: Mary Walker
fne.text: Victory -1. [star] Forced Response: After you reveal a side scheme, remove all damage from here and flip this card.

rainy.name: * Thor
rainy.subtitle: Jane Foster
rainy.text: Worthy — Action: Search your deck and discard pile for the Mjolnir upgrade and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)

rainy.name: * Jane Foster
rainy.text: Survivor — Jane Foster gets +1 hand size while her Chemotherapy obligation is set aside or removed from the game. Physician — Action: Heal 1 damage from another friendly character. (Limit once per round.)

rainy.name: * Odinson
rainy.text: Multiverse. [star] Response: After Odinson attacks, choose a player. Deal 1 damage to each minion engaged with that player.

rainy.name: * Roz Solomon
rainy.text: [star] Interrupt: When Roz Solomon thwarts, exhaust Congress of Worlds or a [[S.H.I.E.L.D]] card you control → she gets +2 THW for that use.

rainy.name: Hammer Swing
rainy.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Mjolnir and spend 1 resource of any type → deal 4 damage to an enemy. Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, exhaust Mjolnir → prevent all of that damage.

rainy.name: Lightning Strike
rainy.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy and 1 damage to each enemy engaged with you. If you paid for this card using only [energy] resources, stun an enemy.

rainy.name: Stand Fast
rainy.text: Hero Action: Ready Thor and Mjolnir. If you paid for this card using only [energy] resources, give Thor a tough status card.

rainy.name: * Mjolnir
rainy.text: Restricted. Thor gets +1 ATK and gains the [[AERIAL]] trait. Hero Action (attack): Discard Mjolnir → deal 2 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged.

rainy.name: Unyielding
rainy.text: Hero Response (thwart): After you are attacked and take no damage, exhaust Unyielding → remove 2 threat from a scheme. You may spend 1 resource of any type to ready your hero.

rainy.name: Congress of Worlds
rainy.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Congress of Worlds and spend 1 resource of any type → remove 2 threat from the main scheme or 3 threat from a side scheme.

rainy.name: Medical Clinic
rainy.text: Jane Foster gets +2 REC. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Medical Clinic and spend 1 resource → heal 3 damage from an identity.

rainy.name: Scrying Pool
rainy.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Scrying Pool → look at the top card of a deck. You may discard that card. If a treachery was looked at this way, remove 1 threat from a scheme. If an event was looked at from a player deck this way, that player draws 1 card.

rainy.name: Goddess of Thunder
rainy.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Goddess of Thunder → generate a [energy] resource, or [energy][energy] resources instead for a Thor card.

rainy.name: Mighty
rainy.text:
You get +2 hit points.
Thor gets +1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.

rainy.name: Chemotherapy
rainy.text:
Give to the Jane Foster player.
Flip to alter-ego form. Choose:
- Exhaust Jane Foster and Medical Clinic → remove Chemotherapy from the game.
- Choose to either discard 2 cards or take 2 damage. Discard this obligation.

rainy.name: War of the Realms
rainy.text: When Revealed: Each player takes 1 indirect damage for each character they control.

rainy.name: * Malekith
rainy.text: [star] Forced Response: After Malekith activates, each player takes 1 indirect damage.

rainy.name: * War Witches
rainy.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When War Witches would attack, they scheme instead. Forced Response: After threat is placed on the main scheme, the engaged player takes 1 indirect damage.

rainy.name: Execute
rainy.text: When Revealed: Defeat the ally in play with the highest remaining hit points. If no ally was defeated this way, this card gains surge.

rainy.name: Hostile Takeover
rainy.text: When Revealed: Choose to either discard the support you control with the highest cost or take damage equal to its cost (this damage ignores tough status cards). If no support was discarded and no damage was taken this way, this card gains surge.

albert.name: * Albert
albert.text: Initiate Protocol — Special: Draw 1 card. After you play that card this round, ready Albert. Action: Resolve Albert's "Initiate Protocol" ability. (Limit once per round.)

albert.name: * Albert
albert.text: Extensive Development — Setup: Search your deck and discard pile for an [[Enhancement]] upgrade and put it into play.

albert.name: * Elsie-Dee
albert.text: Interrupt: When Elsie-Dee would be defeated by taking excess damage, deal X damage among enemies in play, where X is equal to the excess amount.

albert.name: Guard Protocol
albert.text: Hero Action: Until the end of the round Albert gains retaliate 1 while in hero form. Give Albert a tough status card. If he already has a tough status card, resolve Albert's "Initiate Protocol" ability.

albert.name: Lethal Directive
albert.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If that enemy is defeated by this attack, resolve Albert's "Initiate Protocol" ability.

albert.name: Sabotage Sequence
albert.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If this thwart removes the last threat from that scheme, resolve Albert's "Initiate Protocol" ability.

albert.name: System Relaunch
albert.text: Alter-Ego Action: Heal damage from Albert equal to your REC and change to hero form → resolve Albert's "Initiate Protocol" ability.

albert.name: * Donald Pierce
albert.text: Resource: Exhaust Donald Pierce → generate a [wild] resource. Response: After you resolve Albert's "Initiate Protocol" ability, ready this card.

albert.name: Adamantium Claws
albert.text: While in hero form, Albert gets +1 ATK and his basic attacks gain piercing.

albert.name: Genius-Level Intellect
albert.text:
You gain the [[Genius]] trait.
While in hero form, Albert gets +1 THW.

albert.name: Kevlar Shell
albert.text: While in hero form, Albert gets +1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.

albert.name: Counterpart Elimination
albert.text: Give to the Albert player. You cannot resolve Albert's "Initiate Protocol" ability. When Revealed: Find a [[Wolverine]] minion and reveal it. Response: After a [[Wolverine]] minion is defeated, discard this card.

albert.name: * Wolverine
albert.text: Forced Response: After you attack Wolverine, heal 1 damage from him. (Albert's nemesis minion.) [star] Boost: Put this minion into play engaged with the Albert player.

albert.name: Crack in the Multiverse
albert.text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After the player phase ends, the first player finds a [[Wolverine]] minion and reveals it.

albert.name: * Patch
albert.text: Retaliate 1. When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each player.

albert.name: * Weapon X
albert.text: Quickstrike. When Revealed: Discard 1 random card from your hand.

albert.name: * Zombie Wolvie
albert.text: When Defeated: Shuffle Zombie Wolvie into the encounter deck.

gwenpool.name: * Gwenpool
gwenpool.text: Medium Awareness — Interrupt: When you resolve an ability on a Gwenpool card, replace "____" with a phrase from a speech bubble. (Use bubbles on a card you are playing, a card you spend, or a card in play.) (Limit each bubble once per phase.) Speech bubble: “Draw 1 card.”

gwenpool.name: * Gwendolyn Poole
gwenpool.text: "I Won't Be an Extra" — Action: Find a Gwenpool card and add it to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)

gwenpool.name: "Here I Come!"
gwenpool.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. This attack gains overkill. If this attack defeats an enemy, ____. Speech bubble: “Deal 2 damage to the villain.”

gwenpool.name: "It Can't End Like This!"
gwenpool.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal 1 damage to the villain and remove 1 threat from the main scheme. If the villain schemed last round, ____. Speech bubble: “Confuse the villain.”

gwenpool.name: Fun Background Noise
gwenpool.text: Hero Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its "When Revealed" effects and discard it. Then, ____. Speech bubble: “Give Gwenpool a tough status card.”

gwenpool.name: "Sorry, Gotta Run!"
gwenpool.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. This thwart ignores the patrol keyword and crisis icons. If this thwart defeats a scheme, ____. Speech bubble: “Remove 2 threat from the main scheme.”

gwenpool.name: Endless Storylines
gwenpool.text: Hero Response: After you spend this card, ____ and ____. Speech bubbles: “Remove 1 threat from a scheme.” / “Heal 1 damage from Gwenpool.” / “Deal 1 damage to an enemy.”

gwenpool.name: * Gwen's Room
gwenpool.text: You get +1 REC. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Gwen's Room → heal 1 damage from Gwendolyn Poole. Then, find Unbelievable Gwenpool and add it to your hand. Speech bubble: “Heal 1 damage from Gwenpool.”

gwenpool.name: * Comicbook Panels
gwenpool.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Comicbook Panels → generate a [wild] resource and ____. Hero Action: Exhaust Comicbook Panels and Unbelievable Gwenpool → ____ and ____. Speech bubble: “Look at the top card of any deck.”

gwenpool.name: * Unbelievable Gwenpool
gwenpool.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Unbelievable Gwenpool → search your deck for a Gwenpool card and attach it faceup here (to a maximum of 1). (Shuffle.) You may use the speech bubbles of the attached card. Hero Action: Draw 2 cards and ____. Discard Unbelievable Gwenpool. Speech bubble: “Ready Gwenpool.”

gwenpool.name: THE END
gwenpool.text: Give to the Gwendolyn Poole player. You cannot use speech bubbles from Gwenpool cards. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Gwendolyn Poole and discard Unbelievable Gwenpool → remove THE END from the game.

gwenpool.name: Rules of the Universe
gwenpool.text: Permanent. While there is no threat here, this scheme loses the [hazard] icon. Forced Interrupt: When you resolve an ability on a Gwenpool card, replace "____" with the phrase from the speech bubble on Evil Gwenpool.

gwenpool.name: * Evil Gwenpool
gwenpool.text: Steady. Villainous. When Defeated: Shuffle Evil Gwenpool into the encounter deck. (Gwenpool's nemesis minion.) [star] Boost: Put Evil Gwenpool into play engaged with you. Speech bubble: “Gwenpool takes 1 damage.”

gwenpool.name: Break Reality
gwenpool.text: Incite 1. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck for Evil Gwenpool and reveal her. (Shuffle.) If Unbelievable Gwenpool is in play, she gains quickstrike. If Evil Gwenpool was already in play, add 2[per_hero] threat to Rules of the Universe.

gwenpool.name: "Future Me Scares Me"
gwenpool.text: Incite 0 (incite 1 instead, if this is a multiplayer game). Incite 1 (incite 2 instead, if this is an expert mode game). When Revealed: If Evil Gwenpool is in play, add 2 threat to Rules of the Universe and shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

human_torch.name: * Human Torch
human_torch.text: Flame On! — Interrupt: When you place a flame counter on an enemy, deal 1 damage to that enemy. An enemy cannot have more than 3 flame counters on them.

human_torch.name: * Johnny Storm
human_torch.text: Ignition — Action: Exhaust Johnny Storm → search the top 4 cards of your deck for a [[FIRE]] card and add it to your hand. If no cards were added to your hand this way, ready Johnny Storm. (Limit once per round.)

human_torch.name: * The Thing
human_torch.subtitle: Ben Grimm
human_torch.text: Toughness. Response: After The Thing defends, ready him. (Limit once per phase.)

human_torch.name: Johnny's Workshop
human_torch.text: Response: After you change to Johnny Storm, draw 1 card. Response: After you change to Human Torch, ready a [[FIRE]] card.

human_torch.name: Unstable Uniform
human_torch.text: Human Torch gets +1 DEF. Hero Response: After you take damage from an attack, place a flame counter on the attacker.

human_torch.name: Internal Combustion
human_torch.text: Hero Action: Remove 3 flame counters from an enemy and discard Internal Combustion → draw 3 cards.

human_torch.name: Spark
human_torch.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Spark → generate an [energy] resource for a [[FIRE]] card. Hero Action: Exhaust Spark → place a flame counter on an enemy.

human_torch.name: Fly-By
human_torch.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme, then remove 1 threat from a scheme for each flame counter on the villain.

human_torch.name: Blaze and Daze
human_torch.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. Then, if they have 3 flame counters on them, remove all those counters and stun that enemy.

human_torch.name: Radiate
human_torch.text: Choose one: Hero Action (attack): Place 2 flame counters on X enemies. Action: Remove all flame counters from X enemies → change your form, then heal 1 damage for each flame counter removed this way (to a maximum of 5).

human_torch.name: Nova Flame
human_torch.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Human Torch → place up to 3 flame counters on an enemy, then deal 7 damage to that enemy. This attack gains overkill.

human_torch.name: Flame Off
human_torch.text:
Give to the Johnny Storm player.
Flip to alter-ego form and remove all flame counters from enemies in play. Then:
- If up to 3 counters were removed this way, discard this obligation.
- If 4 or more flame counters were removed this way, remove Flame Off from the game.

human_torch.name: * Hydro-Man
human_torch.text: Hydro-Man cannot have flame counters placed on him. [star] Boost: Put Hydro-Man into play engaged with you.

human_torch.name: Dam It
