determination.text: Alliance. Hero Action (attack): Exhaust an AVENGER character and a GUARDIAN character and deal 1 damage to each of them → deal a total of 6 damage divided among enemies as you choose. If neither of these friendly characters were defeated this way, ready them.

determination.name: "That All You Got?"
determination.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Search the encounter deck for an attachment. Reveal that attachment → draw 3 cards. (Shuffle the encounter deck.)

determination.name: * Human Torch
determination.text: Forced Response: After your turn begins, deal 1 damage to the villain, each minion engaged with you, your hero, and each other ally you control.

determination.name: Resistance Training
determination.text: Max 2 per deck. Uses (2 training counters). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 training counter from it → choose a Determination (purple) event in your discard pile and shuffle it into your deck.

determination.name: * Colleen Wing
determination.text:
Fragile.
Colleen Wing gets +1 THW while Misty Knight is in play, and gets +1 ATK while attacking enemies with the Bounty upgrade attached.

determination.name: * Misty Knight
determination.text: Action: Exhaust Misty Knight and deal 1 damage to her → choose one: • Search your deck and discard pile for a copy of the Bounty upgrade and add it to your hand. • Reduce the resource cost of the next Bounty upgrade you play this turn by 1.

determination.name: Bounty
determination.text: Attach to a minion with the BRUTE, CRIMINAL, or MERCENARY trait, or to a unique (✦) enemy. Max 1 per enemy. Response: After attached enemy is attacked and defeated, the owner of this card draws 2 cards. If the attacker has the HERO FOR HIRE trait, heal 1 damage from them.

determination.name: Duo-Gun
determination.text: Attach to an ally. Max 1 per ally. Uses (1 ammo counter and 1 charge counter.) Action: Exhaust Duo-Gun and choose one: • Remove 1 ammo counter from it → attached ally's next attack gains piercing. • Remove 1 charge counter from it → attached ally's next attack gains overkill.

determination.name: Incentivized
determination.text: Attach to an ally. Max 1 per ally. Interrupt: When attached ally attacks an enemy, it gets +X ATK for that attack, where X is the number of cards attached to that enemy.

determination.name: Munitions Cache
determination.text: Enters play with 2 ammo counters and 2 charge counters. Max 1 per player. Action: Exhaust Munitions Cache → move 1 ammo counter or 1 charge counter from this card to another upgrade you control.

determination.name: Go Wild
determination.text: Requirement ([wild][physical]). Max 2 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Take 2 damage → draw 3 cards and deal X damage to an enemy, where X is the combined printed resource cost of those cards.

determination.name: * Red Dagger
determination.text: Hero Action: Place 1 acceleration token on Red Dagger. (Limit once per phase.) Interrupt: When Red Dagger attacks, resolve this attack X times, where X is the number of acceleration tokens in play.

determination.name: * Starling
determination.text: Fragile. Hero Response: After Starling takes 5 or more damage from an attack, your hero gains +1 ATK until the end of the game.

determination.name: In the Wings
determination.text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Interrupt: When the villain attacks, if your identity has the AERIAL trait, give the villain 1 additional boost card for that activation and discard this card → put the topmost ally in your discard pile into play. Declare it the defender for that attack. Then, confuse the villain.

determination.name: Multiverse Shenanigans
determination.text: Setup. Max 1 per deck. Forced Interrupt: When the game begins, choose any 3 different non-determination aspect cards from your collection and set them aside. Action: Exhaust this card and deal yourself a facedown encounter card → search the set-aside area for 1 of these chosen cards and add it to your hand.

determination.name: * Gorilla-Man
determination.text: Gorilla-Man ignores « Max 1 per ally. » text on upgrades.

determination.name: * Hit-Monkey
determination.text: Interrupt: When Hit-Monkey would take any amount of consequential damage, look at the top card of the encounter deck → prevent 1 of that damage for each boost ([boost]) and star ([star]) icon looked at this way.

determination.name: Cumbersome Enhancements
determination.text: Play only if your hero has a printed hand size of 4 or fewer. Max 1 per deck. Your hero gets +2 hand size. Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, choose to discard this card or place 1 acceleration token here.

determination.name: Borrowed Gear
determination.text: Attach to an ally. Max 1 per deck. Attached ally gets +1 hit point for each upgrade attached to them (to a maximum of +4 hit points). Forced Response: After Borrowed Gear enters play, attach an ally from your discard pile facedown here → attached ally gains that facedown ally's TRAITS.

determination.name: * Masacre
determination.text: Hero Response: After Masacre enters play, search your deck and discard pile for a copy of the Merc Squad support and put it into play. Hero Action: Deal 1 damage to Masacre → place 1 tactic counter on each Merc Squad you control. (Limit once per round.)

determination.name: Sword Training
determination.text: Attach to an X-MEN ally. Max 1 TRAINING upgrade per ally. Response: After attached ally makes an attack that removes a tough status card from an enemy, stun that enemy.

determination.name: Tough Call
determination.text: Hero Action: Take 2 damage → give a character a tough status card. If a tough status card was given to an enemy this way, heal 4 damage from your hero.

determination.name: Excessive Force
determination.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal X damage to an enemy. This attack gains piercing. If that enemy is defeated by this attack, draw X cards. Then, if this attack removed a tough status card, draw 2 additional cards.

determination.name: Off the Cuff
determination.text: Requirement ([wild]). Hero Action: Search your deck, hand, and discard pile for a copy of the Spontaneity upgrade and put it into play. If it is already in play, deal 1 damage to a character. Then, place a status card on that character.

determination.name: * ForgetMeNot
determination.text: ForgetMeNot does not count against your ally limit. Response: After you take damage from a Determination (purple) card, deal 1 damage to ForgetMeNot → heal 2 damage from your identity.

determination.name: Aggressively Disarmed
determination.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
While your hero's remaining hit points are less than half your hero's starting hit points, your hero gets -1 hand size and +2 ATK.

determination.name: "Get 'Em, Boom-Boom!"
determination.text: Hero Response: After you take damage, attach to an enemy. Fleeting. (This card must be discarded from play at the end of the phase.) Interrupt: When this card would be discarded from attached enemy, deal 1 damage to each enemy in play.

determination.name: False Security
determination.text: Attach to a minion and give that minion a tough status card. Forced Response: After a tough status card is discarded from attached minion, discard False Security → ready a friendly character.

determination.name: Concatenate
determination.text: Attach to an enemy. Hero Interrupt (attack): When you attack attached enemy, discard each TACTIC upgrade attached to them → deal 2 damage to that enemy for each upgrade discarded this way. This attack gains overkill.

determination.name: Psychic Crowd Control
determination.text: Play only if your identity has the PSIONIC trait. Hero Action: Exhaust your identity → choose to either confuse each minion engaged with you or deal 2 damage to each confused enemy.

determination.name: Determined Energy
determination.text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Interrupt: When you spend this card to play a TACTIC card, give an ally and minion each a tough status card.

determination.name: * X-23
determination.text: Reckless. (After this character enters play, place 1 threat on each scheme.) [star] Forced Response: After X-23 thwarts, heal 2 damage from her.

determination.name: Lightning Rod
determination.text: Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion. Forced Interrupt: When a card from the standard encounter set is revealed, discard Lightning Rod → deal 6 damage to attached minion. Excess damage from this ability is dealt to the character with the most cards attached to them.

determination.name: Diversion Skill
determination.text: Uses (3 diversion counters). Max 1 per player. Interrupt: When you take damage from an attack, take 1 additional damage and remove 1 diversion counter from here → draw 1 card.

determination.name: Last Legs
determination.text: Play only if your identity has the X-MEN trait. Hero Action (attack/thwart): Discard each X-MEN ally you control → remove X threat from among schemes in play and deal X damage among enemies in play, where X is equal to the number of remaining hit points from allies discarded this way.

determination.name: * Purple Peril
determination.text: Victory 0. Only the owner of this card can remove threat from here. Hero Response: After this card is placed in the victory display, discard X cards from the top of your deck, and add each Determination card discarded this way to your hand (to a maximum of 5), where X is the number of cards in the victory display.

determination.name: Timeslide
determination.text: Hero Response: After a card you control is defeated, choose one: • Place it in the victory display and draw 1 card. • Play a Determination card from the victory display with a printed cost of X for free, where X is less than the number of friendly cards you have placed in the victory display.

determination.name: * Bedlam
determination.text: Victory 0. Hero Resource: Defeat Bedlam → generate [physical][mental][energy] resources.

determination.name: * Marrow
determination.text: Reckless. [star] Interrupt: When Marrow attacks, discard the top card of your deck. If an [energy] or [physical] resource was discarded this way, this attack gains piercing and ranged.

determination.name: * Archangel
determination.subtitle: Warren Worthington III
determination.text: Alias. (If you control a card with a matching subtitle, discard it and play this card for free.) Reckless. Retaliate 2. Response: After an AERIAL character uses a basic power, exhaust Archangel and deal 1 damage to him → ready that character.

determination.name: * Darkhawk
determination.text: [star] Enters play with a configuration counter on his ATK. Darkhawk gets +2 to the power with a counter on it. Action: Exhaust Darkhawk → move the configuration counter onto his other basic power.

determination.name: * A Dangerous Game
determination.text: You cannot move more than 4 threat to this card per turn. Hero Action: Take up to 4 damage → move that amount of threat from another scheme to here. Forced Response: After threat is placed here, if there is at least 16 [per_hero] threat here, deal 16 [per_hero] damage to the villain and remove this card from the game.

determination.name: In the Line of Fire
determination.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal a total of 5 damage divided among characters as you choose. Then, each player draws 1 card for each AERIAL character under their control damaged this way.

determination.name: Divert Attention
determination.text: Play only if there is a side scheme in the victory display. Hero Action: Move up to 6 threat from a scheme onto other schemes in play divided as evenly as possible.

determination.name: * Venompool
determination.subtitle: Wade Wilson
determination.text: Alias. Venompool gets +1 ATK for each facedown encounter card in front of you (to a maximum of +3 ATK). Forced Response: After Venompool enters play, choose to either place 2 threat on the main scheme or deal yourself a facedown encounter card.

determination.name: * Captain Universe
determination.subtitle: Wade Wilson
determination.text: Alias. Interrupt: When Captain Universe would take any amount of consequential damage, reduce that amount by X, where X is the number of facedown encounter cards in front of you.

determination.name: * Zenpool
determination.subtitle: Wade Wilson
determination.text: Alias. Interrupt: When Zenpool enters play, spend any number of resources. Discard 1 facedown encounter card in front of you for each resource spent this way.

determination.name: Defy the Future
determination.text: Hero Action: Look at the top card of the encounter deck and each facedown encounter card in front of you. You may discard any number of cards looked at this way. Deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card for each card discarded this way.

determination.name: Phase Shift
determination.text: Hero Action: Choose a friendly character in any game area (including the mission area), player's deck, or hand → until that character is flipped or enters a discard pile, treat them as if they have an additional printed [wild] resource and a blank text box (except for TRAITS).

determination.name: Temporal Bubble
determination.text: Hero Action: Choose to either discard X cards from your hand and take X damage or deal yourself X facedown encounter cards → ready X cards you control.

determination.name: * Morph
determination.text: Forced Interrupt: When Morph's text box would be treated as blank, Morph gets +2 THW and +2 ATK until he leaves play.

determination.name: * Spiral
determination.text: [star] Spiral gets +1 ATK for each facedown card in front of you. She cannot have greater than 6 ATK. Forced Response: After Spiral enters play, deal yourself 2 facedown encounter cards.

determination.name: * Tabula Rasa
determination.text: Attach to a friendly character with a blank text box (except for TRAITS). Hero Resource: Exhaust attached character → generate their printed resources for an event.

determination.name: * Blink
determination.text: Action: Exhaust Blink and deal 1 damage each to her and your identity → choose to either ready a LOCATION card or change your form.

determination.name: Whatever it Takes
determination.text: Alliance. Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal up to 3 damage to an X-MEN character and up to 3 damage to an X-FORCE character → remove X threat from among schemes in play and deal X damage among enemies in play, where X is the total amount of damage taken this way.

determination.name: * Agent Koenig
determination.text: Fragile. [star] Agent Koenig enters play with 1 LMD counter on him. While there are 1 or more counters on him, he gets +1 ATK. Interrupt: When Agent Koenig would be defeated, remove 1 LMD counter from him → remove all damage from him instead.

determination.name: * The Behemoth
determination.text: Uses (2 deploy counters). Action: Exhaust The Behemoth, remove 1 deploy counter from it, and discard an ally you control → search your collection or deck for a S.H.I.E.L.D. ally and put it into play.

determination.name: * The Peak
determination.text: Response: After you remove an all-purpose counter from a card you control, place it here (to a maximum of 6 counters here). Action: Discard The Peak and 1 card from your hand → deal 1 damage to the villain and remove 1 threat from a scheme for each counter discarded this way.

determination.name: Tech Support
determination.text: Uses (2 stimulant counters). Response: After you remove an all-purpose counter from a card you control, exhaust Tech Support and remove a stimulant counter from it → ready a S.H.I.E.L.D. character or PERSONA support.

determination.name: Jury Rigged Tech
determination.text: Interrupt: When a boost card is turned faceup, discard Jury Rigged Tech and the top card of your deck → if that card's printed cost is greater than X, where X is the number of icons ([star] and [boost]) on the boost card, place a total of X all-purpose counters on cards you control. Then, discard the boost card.

determination.name: Radioactive Burst
determination.text: You get -1 hit point. Hero Response: After you change form, discard Radioactive Burst → resolve this card's « Special » ability. Special: Deal damage to an enemy equal to your ATK. If 3 or more damage was dealt this way, stun that enemy.

determination.name: * Spiders-Man
determination.text: Uses (5 spider counters). Fragile. [star] Spiders-Man cannot leave play while he has 1 or more spider counters. Forced Interrupt: When Spiders-Man uses a basic power, remove 1 or more spider counters from here → deal 1 damage to an enemy for each counter removed this way.

determination.name: * Ralph
determination.text: Hero Interrupt: When your hero attacks an enemy, attach Ralph to that enemy and look at 2 cards from among the top of the encounter deck and encounter cards dealt to players → that attack gains piercing and deals X additional damage to both that enemy and Ralph, where X is the number of boost icons ([boost]) looked at this way.

determination.name: Target Painted
determination.text:
Play only if your identity has the SOLDIER trait. Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion.
Attacks against attached minion gain ranged and deal 1 additional damage for each card attached to that minion.

determination.name: * Night Thrasher
determination.text: Night Thrasher enters play exhausted. Retaliate 2. Response: After you flip a card you control, ready Night Thrasher.

determination.name: * Rage
determination.text:
Rage enters play exhausted.
[star] Rage gets +X ATK, where X is equal to the villain's stage number.

determination.name: Collective Breather
determination.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Heal 2 damage from each damaged enemy → ready a friendly character for each enemy healed this way.

determination.name: * MRVL Network
determination.text: Uses (3 replay counters). Response: After an enemy takes damage during the villain phase, remove 1 replay counter from here → ready a character you control.

determination.name: Determined Conditioning
determination.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
You get +3 hit points, and your hero gets -1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.

determination.name: Timed Detonation
determination.text: Attach to an enemy. Max 1 per enemy. Forced Interrupt (Hero) (attack): When the villain phase ends, flip to alter-ego form and remove Timed Detonation from the game → deal 6 damage to attached enemy. This attack gains ranged and overkill.

determination.name: * Speedball
determination.text: Speedball enters play exhausted. Response: After you ready Speedball, place 1 ball counter on him (to a maximum of 2). Reduce the amount of damage Speedball takes from enemy attacks by 1 for each ball counter on him.

determination.name: Enraged Energy
determination.text: Double the number of resources this card generates while your hero's remaining hit points are less than half your hero's starting hit points.

determination.name: * Orka
determination.text:
Increase the cost to play this card by 1 if you do not control any HERO FOR HIRE characters.
[star] Orka gets +1 ATK for each character with the fragile keyword you control or are engaged with.

determination.name: * Paladin
determination.text: Villainous. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Paladin attacks an enemy with 1 or more determination (purple) upgrades attached, give him 1 additional boost card for that attack.

determination.name: * Tarantula
determination.text: Fragile. Tarantula gains a [boost] icon for each damage token here. Forced Response: After Tarantula thwarts a side scheme or attacks a minion and does not exactly defeat it, she takes 1 additional consequential damage.

determination.name: Leverage Impediments
determination.text: [star] Discount 1 (MARTIAL ARTIST). Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 additional damage to that enemy for each card attached to it. If this attack exactly defeats that enemy, heal 2 damage from your identity.

determination.name: Calculated Action
determination.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal X damage to an enemy and remove Y threat from a scheme, where the total of X + Y is equal to 6. If a card was exactly defeated this way, ready your hero. Otherwise, take 1 damage.

determination.name: Assessed for Weakness
determination.text: Attach to a minion. Attached minion gains fragile. Interrupt: When you would deal any amount of damage to attached minion, choose to either increase or decrease that amount by 1.

determination.name: Flummoxed
determination.text: [star] If your remaining hit points are less than half your maximum hit points, reduce the cost of this card by 1. Attach to an ally or non-ELITE minion. Treat attached character's printed text box as blank (except for TRAITS).

determination.name: Path of Mercy
determination.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 ETHOS card per player. Hero Response: After you attack a minion, if that minion has exactly 1 hit point remaining, draw 1 card. Then, if you are the only player in this game, discard that minion.

determination.name: Path of Penance
determination.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 ETHOS card per player. Hero Response: After you attack a minion, if that attack dealt any amount of excess damage, take that amount of damage → for each damage taken this way, choose a player to draw 1 card. (Limit once per player per minion.)

determination.name: Path of Temperance
determination.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 ETHOS card per player. Hero Response: After you attack a minion, if that attack exactly defeated that minion, each player may discard 1 card from their hand and draw 1 card.

spot.name: Heightened Threat
spot.text: Contents: The Spot I & II (The Spot III & IV for expert mode), The Spot and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (recommended: Sinister Syndicate). Setup: Find the What Goes Around... environment and put side A into play (side B instead for expert mode). The first player seeks a Spot card with the Threat Level keyword and reveals it. Shuffle.

spot.name: Heightened Threat
spot.text: Forced Interrupt: When you would remove any amount of threat from here or a Spot side scheme, move that threat to the card with the highest Threat Level instead. (Threat Level is the number in the red icon. If the side scheme you removed threat from has the highest Threat Level number in play, remove that threat.) If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

spot.name: * The Spot
spot.text:
[star] Threat Level 1. Characters may thwart against The Spot.
Hinder 1[per_hero]. The Spot gains retaliate 1 for every 5[per_hero] threat here, to a maximum of retaliate 3.

spot.name: * The Spot
spot.text:
[star] Threat Level 1. Characters may thwart against The Spot.
Hinder 3[per_hero]. Steady. The Spot gains retaliate 1 for every 5[per_hero] threat here, to a maximum of retaliate 3.

spot.name: * The Spot
spot.text:
[star] Threat Level 1. Characters may thwart against The Spot.
Hinder 3[per_hero]. The Spot gains retaliate 1 for every 5[per_hero] threat here, to a maximum of retaliate 4.

spot.name: * The Spot
spot.text:
[star] Threat Level 1. Characters may thwart against The Spot.
Hinder 5[per_hero]. Stalwart. The Spot gains retaliate 1 for every 5[per_hero] threat here, to a maximum of retaliate 4.

spot.name: What Goes Around...
spot.text: Standard Mode Only. Forced Interrupt: When a card that belongs to The Spot encounter set (ie. a « Spot card ») is revealed, place 1 threat on the main scheme. Hero Action: Discard a card from hand → move up to 3 threat from one Spot card with the Threat Level keyword to a different Spot card with the Threat Level keyword.

spot.name: What Goes Around...
spot.text: Expert Mode Only. Forced Interrupt: When a Spot card is revealed or turned faceup as a boost card, place 1 threat on the main scheme (limit 1 threat per Spot card per phase). Hero Action: Discard a card from hand → move up to 3 threat from one Spot card with the Threat Level keyword to a different Spot card with the Threat Level keyword.

spot.name: * Rocket Racer
spot.text: Threat Level 2. Rocket Racer gains patrol and guard while he has 2[per_hero] or more threat on him. [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

spot.name: * Puma
spot.text: Threat Level 3. Puma gets +1 ATK for every 2[per_hero] threat on him. [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

spot.name: Anywhere & Everywhere
spot.text: Threat Level 4. Forced Response: When the villain phase ends, if there is 3[per_hero] or greater threat here, place 1[per_hero] threat on each card in play with the Threat Level keyword. [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

spot.name: * Chameleon
spot.text: Threat Level 5. Chameleon gets +1 SCH for every 2[per_hero] threat on him. [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

spot.name: Penchant for Pilfery
spot.text: Threat Level 6. Forced Response: When the villain phase ends, if there is 4[per_hero] or greater threat here, each player chooses to either discard a card they control or take 2 damage. [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

spot.name: * Living Laser
spot.text: Threat Level 7. Living Laser gains retaliate 1 for every 2[per_hero] threat on him (to a maximum of retaliate 4). [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

spot.name: Spotty Pasts
spot.text: Threat Level 8. Forced Response: When the villain phase ends, if there is 5[per_hero] or greater threat here, the first player finds a Spot minion and reveals it. [star] Boost: Reveal this card.

spot.name: Warp Hole
spot.text: Threat Level 9. Hinder 5. While there is 3 or more threat here, this card gains [[acceleration]] [[hazard]]. Hero Response: After an attack deals 3 or more damage to The Spot, remove 2 threat from here. If the last threat is removed from here this way, discard Warp Hole.

spot.name: * The Hypernova
spot.text: Attach to the Spot enemy with the highest Threat Level. Threat Level 10. Forced Response: After attached enemy activates, discard X cards from the top of the encounter deck, where X is the amount of threat here. If an acceleration token was placed this way, discard this card.

spot.name: ...Comes Around!
spot.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. For each Spot card discarded this way, choose to either place 2 threat on the main scheme or reveal it. If no Spot cards were discarded this way, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck.

spot.name: Distributed Presence
spot.text: When Revealed: Place a total of 5[per_hero] threat among Spot cards in play with the Threat Level keyword as evenly as possible, starting from the lowest Threat Level number. If you placed 5 threat on The Spot this way, you may ready a card you control.

spot.name: Oddballs
spot.text: When Revealed: Place 1 threat on each Spot card with an odd Threat Level number. If 2 or fewer threat was placed this way, discard a card in your hand with an odd printed cost. [star] Boost: Place 2 threat on The Spot.

spot.name: Target Spotted
spot.text: When Revealed: Search the top 8 cards of the encounter deck for The Hypernova and reveal it. If it was not revealed this way, seek a Spot card with the Threat Level keyword and reveal it.

bebop_rocksteady.name: * Bebop
bebop_rocksteady.text: Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, remove 1 knucklehead counter from the [[HOG]] attachment or place 1 threat on the main scheme. Forced Response: After Bebop takes damage, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[HOG]] attachment.

bebop_rocksteady.name: * Bebop
bebop_rocksteady.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Bebop activates, remove 1 knucklehead counter from the [[HOG]] attachment instead. If there are no knucklehead counters there, flip Bebop to his [[ALERT]] side. "My head hurts!"

bebop_rocksteady.name: * Bebop
bebop_rocksteady.text: Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, remove 1 knucklehead counter from the [[HOG]] attachment or place 2 threat on the main scheme. Forced Response: After Bebop takes damage, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[HOG]] attachment.

bebop_rocksteady.name: * Bebop
bebop_rocksteady.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Bebop activates, remove 2 knucklehead counters from the [[HOG]] attachment instead. If there are no knucklehead counters there, flip Bebop to his [[ALERT]] side. "My head hurts!"

bebop_rocksteady.name: * Rocksteady
bebop_rocksteady.text: Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, give Rocksteady a tough status card. Remove 1 knucklehead counter from the [[RHINO]] attachment, or deal 1 damage to the first player. Forced Response: After Rocksteady takes damage, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[RHINO]] attachment.

bebop_rocksteady.name: * Rocksteady
bebop_rocksteady.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Rocksteady activates, remove 1 knucklehead counter from the [[RHINO]] attachment instead. If there are no knucklehead counters there, flip Rocksteady to his [[ALERT]] side. "What just hit me?"

bebop_rocksteady.name: * Rocksteady
bebop_rocksteady.text: Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, give Rocksteady a tough status card. Remove 1 knucklehead counter from the [[RHINO]] attachment, or deal 2 damage to the first player. Forced Response: After Rocksteady takes damage, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[RHINO]] attachment.

bebop_rocksteady.name: * Rocksteady
bebop_rocksteady.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Rocksteady activates, remove 2 knucklehead counters from the [[RHINO]] attachment instead. If there are no knucklehead counters there, flip Rocksteady to his [[ALERT]] side. "What just hit me?"

bebop_rocksteady.name: Demolition Crew
bebop_rocksteady.text: Bebop and Rocksteady are leaving a wake of destruction throughout Manhattan! Content: Bebop (A1) and Rocksteady (A1), (Bebop (B1) and Rocksteady (B1) for expert mode.) Bebop & Rocksteady, Concrete Jungle, and Standard sets. One modular encounter set (Rock the Block). Setup: Put the Destructive Dunderheads environment, Welcome to the Jungle side scheme, Hog Wild attachment, and Rhino Rage attachment into play.

bebop_rocksteady.name: Demolition Crew
bebop_rocksteady.text: As you emerge from the sewers—Bebop and Rocksteady greet you. It seems they were expecting you! [star] Forced Interrupt: When this scheme would be completed, remove all threat from here instead. Then, in player order, Bebop and Rocksteady attack each player (even if they are in alter-ego form).

bebop_rocksteady.name: Destructive Dunderheads
bebop_rocksteady.text: Double Trouble — During step two of the villain phase, both villains activate against each player. Choose either Bebop or Rocksteady as the target for each card that references "the villain". Forced Interrupt: When Bebop or Rocksteady is defeated, set that villain and their [[TEMPER]] attachment aside. Flip the remaining villain to their [[ALERT]] side, and this card to its [[FERAL]] side.

bebop_rocksteady.name: Gone Berserk!
bebop_rocksteady.text:
Permanent. Attach to the villain.
Attached villain cannot be confused.
Attached villain gets +12[per_hero] hit points.

bebop_rocksteady.name: Hog Wild
bebop_rocksteady.text: Permanent. Setup. Attach to Bebop. [star] Bebop gets +1 ATK for each knucklehead counter here. Special: Place 1 knucklehead counter here. If there are at least 3 knucklehead counters here, flip this card to its [[ENRAGED]] side. "Things are about to get wild!" —Bebop

bebop_rocksteady.name: Headfirst

yondu.name: * Sav'rkk
yondu.text: Upgrades cannot be removed from Sav'rkk. When Revealed: Summon the Sword-Gun-Arm attachment and attach it to Sav'rkk. (Yondu's nemesis minion.)

yondu.name: Sword-Gun-Arm
yondu.text: Attach to Sav'rkk. If you cannot, attach to the minion with the highest ATK. If you cannot, this card gains surge. [star] Attached character's attacks gain overkill. Forced Response: When attached character has 2 or less remaining hit points, discard Sword-Gun-Arm.

yondu.name: Hard to Kill
yondu.text:
When Revealed: If Sav'rkk is in play, he heals 2 damage. Otherwise, summon Sav'rkk and reveal him.
[star] Boost: The villain heals 2 damage.

yondu.name: Savage Destruction
yondu.text: When Revealed: If Sav'rkk is in play, he attacks you. Otherwise, summon Sav'rkk and reveal him.

wolverine_x23.name: * Wolverine
wolverine_x23.text: Living Weapon — Response: After Wolverine takes any amount of damage, ready Wolverine. (Limit once per phase.)

wolverine_x23.name: * Laura Kinney
wolverine_x23.text: Shhnk! — Setup: Put Wolverine's Claws into play. Action: Shuffle either the Honey Badger ally or the Sisterly Bond event from your discard pile into your deck → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)

wolverine_x23.name: * Wolverine's Claws
wolverine_x23.text: Permanent. Hero Action: Exhaust Wolverine's Claws and take 2 damage → Wolverine gets +2 ATK until the end of the round.

wolverine_x23.name: * Honey Badger
wolverine_x23.subtitle: Gabby Kinney
wolverine_x23.text: Hero Response: After Honey Badger takes any amount of damage, ready Wolverine.

wolverine_x23.name: Animal Instinct
wolverine_x23.text: Hero Interrupt: When Wolverine makes a basic thwart, she gets +X THW for this thwart, where X is equal to her ATK.

wolverine_x23.name: Claw Mastery
wolverine_x23.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Until the end of the round, Wolverine gets +2 ATK (and her attacks gain overkill while Honey Badger is in play).

wolverine_x23.name: Regenerative Longevity
wolverine_x23.text: Action: Heal a total of 4 damage from your identity and Honey Badger.

wolverine_x23.name: Sisterly Bond
wolverine_x23.text: Hero Interrupt: When Honey Badger thwarts or attacks, add Wolverine's matching power to Honey Badger's power for this use.

wolverine_x23.name: Sisterhood
wolverine_x23.text: Action: Exhaust Sisterhood and discard an Wolverine card from your hand → search your deck and discard pile for Honey Badger and add her to your hand. (Shuffle.)

wolverine_x23.name: Adamantium Lacing
wolverine_x23.text:
You get +2 hit points.
Wolverine gains retaliate 1 and her basic attacks gain piercing.

wolverine_x23.name: Grim Resolve
wolverine_x23.text: Resource: Exhaust this card and take 1 damage → generate a [wild] resource.

wolverine_x23.name: Pain Tolerance
wolverine_x23.text: Response: After you play an Wolverine card (including this one), heal 1 damage from your identity.

wolverine_x23.name: Puncture Wound
wolverine_x23.text: Attach to an enemy that Wolverine or Honey Badger attacked this turn. Attached enemy gets -1 ATK. Forced Response: After the player phase begins, discard this card and deal 3 damage to attached enemy.

dazzler.name: * Dazzler
dazzler.text: Rehearsal — Hero Action: Place 1 sound counter on a [[SONG]] in the Setlist without a sound counter on it → resolve the "Showtime!" effect on that [[SONG]]. (Limit once per phase.)

dazzler.name: * Alison Blaire
dazzler.text: Setup: Find Live Concert and put it into play under your control. Songwriter — Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for a [[SONG]] event and place it into your hand. (Limit once per round.)

dazzler.name: * Longshot
dazzler.text: Longshot enters play with 2 knife counters on him. Interrupt: When Longshot attacks an enemy, remove 1 knife counter from him → choose one: deal 2 damage to an enemy or stun a minion.

dazzler.name: "A Little Girl's Dream"
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Reduce the resource cost of the next ally or event you play this round by 3. Showtime!: Confuse a non-[[ELITE]] enemy.

dazzler.name: "Beautiful Dreamer"
dazzler.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If this removes the last threat from that scheme, you may remove 2 threat from another scheme. Showtime!: Remove 2 threat from a scheme.

dazzler.name: "Beauty and the Beast"
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Search your deck for an ally and put it into play. If that ally is still in play at the end of the phase, add it to your hand. Showtime!: Give a friendly character +2 THW until the end of the phase.

dazzler.name: "Doll"
dazzler.text: Hero Interrupt: When the villain would activate against you, cancel that activation. Showtime!: Give your identity a tough status card.

dazzler.name: "Hush Now Baby"
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Stun and confuse an enemy. Showtime!: Each player draws 1 card.

dazzler.name: "In the Darkest Light"
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Deal 2 damage to each enemy. Showtime!: Stun a non-[[ELITE]] enemy.

dazzler.name: "Out and Proud"
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Defeat a non-[[ELITE]] minion. Showtime!: Heal 1 damage from each ally in play.

dazzler.name: "Rich Angel"
dazzler.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent all of that damage. Showtime!: Heal 2 damage from an identity.

dazzler.name: "The Serpent is Coming"
dazzler.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged. Showtime!: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.

dazzler.name: "Too Good to be True"
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Draw 3 cards. Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. Showtime!: Shuffle 3 cards from your discard pile into your deck.

dazzler.name: "Velvet Sky"
dazzler.text: Hero Interrupt: When a treachery is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel all of its effects and discard it. Showtime!: Remove a status card from a friendly character.

dazzler.name: * Lightbringr
dazzler.text: Events attached to Lightbringr may be played as if they were in your hand. Reduce the resource cost of cards played this way by 1. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Lightbringr → attach 1 [[SONG]] event from your hand facedown here (to a maximum of 3).

dazzler.name: Dazzler's Rollerskates
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Dazzler's Rollerskates → ready Dazzler.

dazzler.name: Sound Collector Suit
dazzler.text: Dazzler gets +1 DEF. Resource: Exhaust Sound Collector Suit → generate a [energy] resource for a [[SONG]] or remove 1 sound counter from a [[SONG]] in the Setlist.

dazzler.name: Live Concert
dazzler.text: Permanent. Setup. Response: After you resolve a [[SONG]] event attach it here, placed in a row to the side of this card (to a maximum of 4). Once placed here, it cannot be swapped with a new card. This is the Setlist. Hero Action: Flip this card to its Showtime! side and reveal it.

dazzler.name: Showtime!
dazzler.text: Permanent. When Revealed: Resolve the "Showtime!" ability on each card in the Setlist, in any order. Then, discard all cards from the Setlist. If 4 cards were discarded this way, you may either deal 4 damage to an enemy or remove 4 threat from a scheme. Flip this card.

dazzler.name: Sound Absorption
dazzler.text: Response: After you spend this card, place 2 sound counters on your identity.

dazzler.name: Performance Anxiety
dazzler.text: Give to the Alison Blaire player. You may flip to alter-ego form. You cannot use your Songwriter ability or use the 'Hero Action' on Live Concert. Action: Exhaust your identity and discard a support or upgrade you control → remove this obligation from the game.

dazzler.name: * Klaw
dazzler.text: Villainous. Forced Response: After Klaw attacks and damages a character, stun that character.

dazzler.name: Solid Sound Body
dazzler.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. Klaw gets +10 hit points. (When this scheme is defeated, Klaw loses those hit points.) When Defeated: Give Klaw a facedown boost card.

dazzler.name: Stealing Sound
dazzler.text: When Revealed: Discard all [[SONG]] events from Dazzler's Setlist. If no cards were discarded this way, this card gains surge.

dazzler.name: Taunting Light
dazzler.text: When Revealed: If you are Dazzler, the villain attacks you. If no attack was made this way, give the villain a facedown boost card and shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

dazzler.name: Song of Aggression
dazzler.text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to an enemy for each [[SONG]] card in your discard pile (to a maximum of 4).

dazzler.name: Song of Justice
dazzler.text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1 threat from a scheme for each [[SONG]] card in your discard pile (to a maximum of 4).

dazzler.name: Song of Leadership
dazzler.text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Action: Exhaust an ally → heal damage from that ally equal to the amount of [[SONG]] cards in your discard pile (to a maximum of 4).

dazzler.name: Song of Protection
dazzler.text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Interrupt (defense): When a friendly character would take any amount of damage, reduce that damage by 1 for each [[SONG]] card in your discard pile (to a maximum of 4).

dazzler.name: "Doom and Gloom"
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Choose: • Ready a friendly character. • Remove a status card from up to 2 friendly characters.

dazzler.name: Love Song
dazzler.text: Hero Action: Choose: • Remove 1+X threat from the main scheme. • Heal 1+X damage from a friendly character. Where X is the number of enemies in play with a status card on them.

dazzler.name: Power Ballad
dazzler.text: Reduce the cost to play Power Ballad by 2 if your identity is Dazzler, Jem, Lila Cheney, Luna Snow or Virgo. Hero Action: Choose: • Remove 2 threat from a scheme. • Deal 2 damage to an enemy.

dazzler.name: Tribute
dazzler.text: Limit 1 per deck. Hero Action: After you play Tribute from your hand, choose 1 non-identity event in your collection. Tribute becomes a copy of that card, (except for its cost) but keeps the [[SONG]] trait, until it is placed in the discard pile.

dazzler.name: Captivating Performance
dazzler.text: Hero Action: If the next card you play this turn is a [[SONG]] event, stun an enemy.

dazzler.name: Duet
dazzler.text: Max 2 per deck. Response: After you play a [[SONG]] card, ready your hero and another friendly character.

dazzler.name: Encore
dazzler.text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Action: Search your discard pile for a [[SONG]] card and add it to your hand.

dazzler.name: * Karaoke Night
dazzler.text: Action: Exhaust Karaoke Night and choose a [[SONG]] in the Setlist → resolve the 'Hero Action' of that card. Discard that card.

dazzler.name: * DJ
dazzler.subtitle: Mark Sheppard
dazzler.text: Forced Response: After DJ enters play, perform the following for each [[SONG]] card used to pay for him: • remove 2 threat from a scheme. • give him a tough status card. • deal 1 damage to an enemy.

dazzler.name: Coolest Team-Up Ever!
dazzler.text: Team-Up (Dazzler and Jubilee). Max 1 per deck. Hero Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its "When Revealed" effects, then choose to either Confuse or Stun up to 2 enemies in play.

dazzler.name: Love from Beyond the Stars
dazzler.text: Team-Up (Dazzler and Longshot). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Choose: • Confuse an enemy. • Stun an enemy. Then, give Dazzler a sound counter and Longshot a knife counter.

superior_iron_man.name: * Superior Iron Man
superior_iron_man.text: “What Else?” — Resource: Deal 1 damage to a friendly character → generate a [wild] resource. (Limit once per phase.)

superior_iron_man.name: * Tony Stark
superior_iron_man.text: Setup: Find Endo-Sym Armor and put it into play. O.P.A. — Action (thwart): Spend X [mental] resources (minimum 1) → remove 1 + X threat from a scheme. (Limit once per phase.)

superior_iron_man.name: Endo-Sym Armor
superior_iron_man.text: Permanent. Setup. Hero Action (attack): Spend X [physical] resources (minimum 1) → deal 2 + X damage to an enemy. (Limit once per phase.) Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, spend X [energy] resources (minimum 1) → prevent 1 + X of that damage. (Limit once per phase.)

superior_iron_man.name: * Teen Abomination
superior_iron_man.subtitle: Jammy
superior_iron_man.text: Teen Abomination enters play with 4 rage counters on him. Forced Response: After Teen Abomination makes a basic attack, remove 1 rage counter from him. [star] Teen Abomination gets +1 ATK for each rage counter on him.

superior_iron_man.name: Daniel Hall
superior_iron_man.text: Usage (3 cash counters). Resource: Remove 1 cash counter from Daniel Hall and exhaust him → generate a [wild] resource. Forced Interrupt: When you would remove the last cash counter from Daniel Hall, choose a card from your hand and discard it.

superior_iron_man.name: Claire Mooney
superior_iron_man.text: Usage (3 cash counters). Resource: Remove 1 cash counter from Claire Mooney and exhaust her → generate a [wild] resource. Forced Interrupt: When you would remove the last cash counter from Claire Mooney, choose a card from your hand and discard it.

superior_iron_man.name: Mason Thomas
superior_iron_man.text: Usage (3 cash counters). Resource: Remove 1 cash counter from Mason Thomas and exhaust him → generate a [wild] resource. Forced Interrupt: When you would remove the last cash counter from Mason Thomas, choose a card from your hand and discard it.

superior_iron_man.name: * Pepper Potts
superior_iron_man.text: Action: Exhaust Pepper Potts → remove 1 threat from a scheme, ignoring its crisis icon.

superior_iron_man.name: Stark Island
superior_iron_man.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Stark Island → search your deck and discard pile for an [[Individual]] support and put it into play under your control, paying its cost. Shuffle your deck.

superior_iron_man.name: Iron Sight
superior_iron_man.text: Usage (2 per hero, observation counters). Interrupt: When a boost card is turned faceup during an activation, remove 1 observation counter from Iron Sight and exhaust it → cancel that card's boost icons.

superior_iron_man.name: Endo-Sym Spare
superior_iron_man.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Endo-Sym Spare → search your discard pile for an Endo-Sym Matter resource card and shuffle it into your deck.

superior_iron_man.name: Spectacular Blast
superior_iron_man.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Remove 2 threat from a scheme.

superior_iron_man.name: Spectacular Save
superior_iron_man.text: Hero Interrupt (defense/thwart): When a friendly character would take any amount of damage, prevent 3 of that damage. Remove 1 threat from a scheme.

superior_iron_man.name: Endo-Sym Matter
superior_iron_man.text: Double the number of resources this card generates when spent to pay for cards specific to your identity (including the cost of abilities on those cards).

superior_iron_man.name: Alone
superior_iron_man.text: Give to the Tony Stark player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Tony Stark → remove Alone from the game. • Spend 3 resources of any type. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

superior_iron_man.name: Massive Attack
superior_iron_man.text: Hinder 2. When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to the Tony Stark player. [star] Boost: Put Massive Attack into play.

superior_iron_man.name: * Tony Stark A.I.
superior_iron_man.text: Armored 2. Guard. Patrol. When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to the Tony Stark player. [star] Deal 1 damage to the Tony Stark player.

superior_iron_man.name: Get My Body Back
superior_iron_man.text: When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to the Tony Stark player, then deal 1 additional damage to the Tony Stark player.

iron_lad.name: * Iron Lad
iron_lad.subtitle: Nathaniel Richards
iron_lad.text: Destiny — Action: Name a resource type and look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Add up to 2 cards with the chosen resource type to your hand and discard the others. (Limit once per round.)

iron_lad.name: * Iron Lad
iron_lad.subtitle: Nathaniel Richards
iron_lad.text: Inventive Genius — Action: Reduce the resource cost of the next [[TECH]] card played this phase by 2. (Limit once per round.)

iron_lad.name: * Stature
iron_lad.subtitle: Cassie Lang
iron_lad.text: Response: After Stature enters play, heal 1 damage from your identity. You may discard up to 3 cards from your deck to heal 1 more damage for each card discarded.

iron_lad.name: Energy Overflow
iron_lad.text: Hero Action: Discard a [[TECH]] card you control → deal 6 damage to X enemies in play, where X is equal to the printed resource cost of the discarded card. This damage ignores tough status cards.

iron_lad.name: Ion Blast
iron_lad.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may discard 5 cards from your deck to deal 6 damage instead.

iron_lad.name: Ion Blast
iron_lad.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may discard 5 cards from your deck to deal 6 damage instead.

iron_lad.name: Ion Blast
iron_lad.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may discard 5 cards from your deck to deal 6 damage instead.

iron_lad.name: Seeking Solutions
iron_lad.text: Alter-Ego Action: Shuffle 2 cards from your discard pile back into your deck. Draw 1 card for each [[TECH]] card shuffled into your deck this way.

iron_lad.name: Seeking Solutions
iron_lad.text: Alter-Ego Action: Shuffle 2 cards from your discard pile back into your deck. Draw 1 card for each [[TECH]] card shuffled into your deck this way.

iron_lad.name: * Vision AI
iron_lad.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Vision AI → shuffle the top card of your discard pile into your deck. Return the bottom card of your discard pile to your hand.

iron_lad.name: Hack
iron_lad.text: Interrupt (thwart): When threat would be placed on a scheme, discard Hack → remove that amount from that scheme instead. Additionally, you may discard 5 cards from your deck to remove the same amount from a different scheme.

iron_lad.name: Ion Amplifiers
iron_lad.text: Uses (X ion counters, where X is equal to the number of [[TECH]] cards you control.) Hero Resource: Exhaust Ion Amplifiers and remove 1 ion counter from it → generate a [wild] resource.

iron_lad.name: Ion Amplifiers
iron_lad.text: Uses (X ion counters, where X is equal to the number of [[TECH]] cards you control.) Hero Resource: Exhaust Ion Amplifiers and remove 1 ion counter from it → generate a [wild] resource.

iron_lad.name: * Iron Lad's Boots
iron_lad.text: Iron Lad gains [[AERIAL]]. Hero Response: After playing an event, exhaust Iron Lad's Boots → return the bottom card of your discard pile to your hand.

iron_lad.name: * Iron Lad's Helmet
iron_lad.text: Hero Response: After Iron Lad uses a basic power, exhaust Iron Lad's Helmet → return the bottom card of your discard pile to your hand.

iron_lad.name: * Iron Lad's Suit
iron_lad.text: You get +3 hit points. Hero Action: Exhaust Iron Lad's Suit → ready Iron Lad.

iron_lad.name: * Neurokinetic Interface
iron_lad.text: Hero Response: After you reveal an encounter card, exhaust Neurokinetic Interface → if that card was: • A treachery or minion, deal 2 damage to an enemy. • A side scheme or attachment, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

iron_lad.name: Shadow of the Future
iron_lad.text: Give to the Nathaniel Richards player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Remove the top 3 cards of your deck from the game → remove Shadow of the Future from the game. • Discard 1 [[TECH]] card you control. Discard 3 cards from your deck. Discard this obligation.

iron_lad.name: Early Start
iron_lad.text: When Revealed: Exhaust each Iron Lad upgrade in play. While this scheme is in play, Iron Lad upgrades cannot be readied.

iron_lad.name: * Kang the Conqueror
iron_lad.text: Toughness. Villainous. When Revealed: Put the highest cost Iron Lad upgrade in play under Kang the Conqueror. When Defeated: Return the upgrade under here to its owner's hand. Set Kang the Conqueror aside.

iron_lad.name: Taking Responsability
iron_lad.text: Forced Response: After you attack or thwart, discard the top card of your deck. Action: Remove the top card of your deck from the game → discard this obligation.

iron_lad.name: Pay the Price
iron_lad.text: When Revealed: Discard 8 cards from your deck. If less than 8 cards were discarded this way, this card gains surge.

iron_lad.name: Pay the Price
iron_lad.text: When Revealed: Discard 8 cards from your deck. If less than 8 cards were discarded this way, this card gains surge.

iron_lad.name: Sudden Plan Change
iron_lad.text: Team-Up (Stature and Iron Lad). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Change to another form. You get +1 hand size until the end of the phase.

kate_bishop.name: * Hawkeye
kate_bishop.text: Master Archer — Interrupt (attack): When an enemy initiates an attack, remove up to 3 arrow counters from Kate's Bow → deal 1 damage to that enemy for each arrow counter removed.

kate_bishop.name: * Kate Bishop
kate_bishop.text: Skillful — During deck building you may include SKILL cards from any aspect. Action: Search your deck and discard pile for Kate's Bow and put it into play. (Limit once per round.)

kate_bishop.name: * Hawkeye
kate_bishop.subtitle: Clint Barton
kate_bishop.text: Interrupt: When Hawkeye would be defeated by consequential damage, shuffle him into your deck and place 1 arrow counter on Kate's Bow.

kate_bishop.name: Evasive Shot
kate_bishop.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent 4 of that damage. Then, deal 1 damage to the attacker for each arrow counter on Kate's Bow (to a maximum of 5).

kate_bishop.name: Infiltrate
kate_bishop.text: Interrupt: When any amount of threat would be placed on a scheme, prevent 2 of that threat (4 instead if you are in alter-ego form).

kate_bishop.name: Quick Draw
kate_bishop.text: Alter-Ego Action: Flip to hero form and ready your hero. Hero Action: Ready your hero and place 2 arrow counters on Kate's Bow.

kate_bishop.name: Smoke Arrow
kate_bishop.text: Hero Interrupt: When an enemy initiates an activation, remove 1 arrow counter from Kate's Bow → cancel that activation. You may spend a resource to flip to alter-ego form or ready your hero.

kate_bishop.name: Anchor Points
kate_bishop.text: Resource: Exhaust Anchor Points → generate a [wild] resource for a SKILL card.

kate_bishop.name: Hawkeye Investigations
kate_bishop.text: Response: After you prevent any amount of threat from being placed on a scheme, remove 1 threat from a scheme. Response: After you prevent any amount of damage, remove 1 threat from a scheme.

kate_bishop.name: Lucky
kate_bishop.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Lucky → heal 2 damage from Kate Bishop and place 1 arrow counter on Kate's Bow.

kate_bishop.name: Athletic Agility
kate_bishop.text: You gain Agile 1. (Reduce damage taken from undefended attacks by 1, to a minimum of 1.) Interrupt: When you prevent any amount of damage from an attack, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

kate_bishop.name: Kate's Aviators
kate_bishop.text: Uses (2 style counters). (Enters play with 2 counters. When those are gone, discard this card.) Hero Action: Exhaust Kate's Aviators and remove 1 style counter from it → draw 1 card.

kate_bishop.name: Kate's Bow
kate_bishop.text: Restricted. Your basic attacks gain ranged. Interrupt: At the end of the player phase, place 1 arrow counter on this card. (Max of 10 arrow counters here.)

kate_bishop.name: Kate's Quiver
kate_bishop.text: You may remove up to 5 arrow counters with your Master Archer Interrupt instead. Resource: Exhaust Kate's Quiver → generate a [wild] resource and place 1 arrow counter on Kate's Bow.

kate_bishop.name: Family = Trouble
kate_bishop.text: Give to the Kate Bishop player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: - Find the hero-specific Hawkeye ally and remove it from the game → remove Family = Trouble from the game. - Remove all arrow counters from Kate's Bow. You cannot place arrow counters on Kate's Bow until the end of the next round. Discard this obligation.

kate_bishop.name: Tandem Archery
kate_bishop.text: Team-Up (Hawkeye (Clint Barton) and Hawkeye (Kate Bishop)). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Ready Hawkeye's Bow or put 2 arrow counters on Kate's Bow. Draw 1 card.

kate_bishop.name: Finding the Perfect LMD
kate_bishop.text:
Madame Masque has managed to get her hands on more Life Model Decoys and is causing havoc with your image!
While this scheme is in play, threat cannot be prevented from being placed on a scheme and Madame Masque cannot take damage.

kate_bishop.name: * Madame Masque

kate_bishop.name: Masque's Minions
kate_bishop.text: Guard. Forced Interrupt: When this minion would be defeated, place 1 minion counter on it and heal all damage from him. Forced Interrupt: When this minion has 2 or more counters on it, discard it.

spider_man_noir.name: Webs Within Webs
spider_man_noir.text: Hero Action (thwart): Discard the top card of the encounter deck → remove threat from a scheme equal to 3 plus the number of boost icons discarded this way. Tuck the discarded card under your hero (to a maximum of 3).

spider_man_noir.name: Web Shot
spider_man_noir.text: Hero Interrupt: When a boost card is turned faceup during an enemy activation, discard it instead and tuck it under Spider-Man Noir (to a maximum of 3).

spider_man_noir.name: Web Swinging
spider_man_noir.text: Hero Response: After Spider-Man Noir uses a basic power, discard a card tucked under Spider-Man Noir → ready Spider-Man Noir. Discard the top card of the encounter deck and tuck it under Spider-Man Noir (to a maximum of 3).

spider_man_noir.name: * The Black Cat Club
spider_man_noir.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust The Black Cat Club and discard a card tucked under your identity → choose to either draw 2 cards or heal 4 damage from your identity.

spider_man_noir.name: Dual Pistols
spider_man_noir.text: Restricted. Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Dual Pistols and discard a card tucked under your hero → deal 3 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged.

spider_man_noir.name: Enhanced Spider-Sense
spider_man_noir.text: Hero Interrupt: When another player reveals a treachery, you reveal it instead and draw 1 card. Hero Interrupt: When the villain initiates an attack against you, draw 1 card.

spider_man_noir.name: Fancy Fedora
spider_man_noir.text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card and discard a card tucked under your hero → remove 2 threat from a scheme. Response: After you thwart and defeat a side scheme, tuck it under your identity from the encounter discard pile (to a maximum of 3 cards).

spider_man_noir.name: Organic Webbing
spider_man_noir.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Organic Webbing and discard a card tucked under Spider-Man Noir → ready Spider-Man Noir. He gains the [[AERIAL]] trait until the end of the round.

spider_man_noir.name: In Walks Trouble
spider_man_noir.text: Give to the Peter Parker player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Peter Parker → remove In Walks Trouble from the game. • Reveal a random card tucked under your identity. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

spider_man_noir.name: Power Struggle
spider_man_noir.text: Electro is draining the city's power reserves. He's giving off sparks and getting stronger by the minute - stop him before it's too late! Forced Interrupt: When a character thwarts this scheme, they take 1 damage.

spider_man_noir.name: * Electro Noir
spider_man_noir.text: Retaliate 1. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Electro Noir activates against you, give him a random encounter card tucked under your identity as a boost card. Otherwise, give him a facedown boost card from the top of the encounter deck. (Spider-Man Noir's nemesis minion.)

spider_man_noir.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
spider_man_noir.text:
When Revealed: Tuck the top card of the encounter deck under your identity (to a maximum of 3 cards). For each icon ([star] and [boost]) in the boost area of cards tucked under your identity, take 1 damage (to a maximum of 4 damage).
[star] Boost: After this activation, this enemy activates again.

spider_man_noir.name: Thunderstorm
spider_man_noir.text: Cards from this set gain surge. Forced Response: After the surge keyword on an encounter card is resolved (including this one), the player resolving it takes 1 indirect damage if they are in hero form. Hero Action: Spend [energy][energy] resources → discard this card.

black_cat.name: * Black Cat
black_cat.text: If there are more than 3 tucked cards here, discard all but 3 of those cards. Tychokinesis — Interrupt: When icons ([star] and [boost]) on an encounter card would be counted, count the icons on a card tucked here instead. Then, discard it.

black_cat.name: * Felicia Hardy
black_cat.text: If there are more than 3 tucked cards here, discard all but 3 of those cards. Cat Burglary — Action: Look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and tuck 1 of them under your identity. (Limit once per round.)

black_cat.name: * Spider-Man
black_cat.subtitle: Peter Parker
black_cat.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Spider-Man uses a basic power, discard the top card of the encounter deck. For each boost icon ([boost]) discarded this way, he gets +1 to that power for that use and takes +1 consequential damage.

black_cat.name: * Spider-Man
black_cat.subtitle: Peter Parker
black_cat.text: Multiverse. Enters play with 2 web counters. Interrupt: When an enemy activates, remove 1 web counter from here and discard a card tucked under your identity → cancel that activation.

black_cat.name: * Big Heist
black_cat.text: Only [[THIEF]] characters can remove threat from this scheme. When Defeated: Choose one: • Search your collection for a basic or aspect upgrade and play it, ignoring its resource cost. • Tuck an attachment in play with the text "Hero Action" or "Hero Response" under Black Cat. • Draw 3 cards.

black_cat.name: Cat Burglary
black_cat.text: Hero Action (thwart): Look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and discard 1. Remove 1 threat from a scheme plus 1 additional threat for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in that card's boost area. Tuck it under Black Cat.

black_cat.name: Lucky Hit
black_cat.text: Hero Action (attack): Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and deal 1 damage to an enemy for each icon ([star] and [boost]) discarded this way. Tuck one of those cards under Black Cat.

black_cat.name: Misfortune
black_cat.text: Hero Interrupt: When a boost card is flipped during an enemy activation, tuck it under your hero instead. That enemy gets -1 ATK and -1 SCH for that activation for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in that card's boost area.

black_cat.name: * Black Cat's Claws
black_cat.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Black Cat's Claws and discard the top card of the encounter deck → deal damage to an enemy equal to the number of icons in that card's boost area. If that number was 0, tuck it under Black Cat.

black_cat.name: Grappling Hook
black_cat.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Grappling Hook and discard a card tucked under Black Cat → ready Black Cat and tuck the top card of the encounter deck under her.

black_cat.name: Ill Gotten Gains
black_cat.text: Resource: Exhaust this card → generate a [wild] resource ([wild][wild] resources instead for an attachment). Response: After you discard an attachment with the text "Hero Action" or "Hero Response" from play, tuck it under your identity.

black_cat.name: Nine Lives
black_cat.text: Hero Interrupt: When Black Cat would take any amount of damage, exhaust Nine Lives and discard the top card of the encounter deck → prevent 1 of that damage for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in that card's boost area.

black_cat.name: Luck's Ran Out
black_cat.text: Give to the Felicia Hardy player. Reveal a random card tucked under your identity. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Discard this card.

cameo_compliment.name: New Suit?
cameo_compliment.text: Setup. Max 1 per deck. Setup: Search your collection for an identity-specific [[ARMOR]] upgrade from an identity not in this game. Shuffle that card into your deck. Discard 2 cards from your hand and remove this card from the game.

sunfire.name: * Sunfire

sunfire.text: Hero Response: After you attach a copy of Burning to an enemy, ready Sunfire.

sunfire.name: Tachyon Whip

ares.name: * Ares' Battle Helm
ares.text: Hero Response: After Ares attacks and defeats an enemy, exhaust Ares' Battle Helm and choose a scheme → remove 1 threat from that scheme for each point of excess damage dealt to that enemy by that attack.

ares.name: God of War
ares.text: Hero Response: After a minion enters play, search your deck for a [[TACTIC]] upgrade that can be attached to that minion and play it on that minion. (Limit once per phase.)

ares.name: Reeling
ares.text:
Attach to a minion. Max 1 per enemy.

ares.name: Sundered
ares.text:
Attach to a minion. Max 1 per enemy.
Increase the amount of damage attached enemy takes from each attack by 1.

ares.text:

[star] Boost: After this activation, deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card.

blade.text: Hero Action (thwart): Search the encounter deck for a minion and put it into play engaged with you → remove 3 threat from a scheme. If that minion has the [[VAMPIRE]] trait, draw 1 card.

blade.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Choose to either heal 2 damage from Blade or place 1 blood counter on him (do both instead if this attack defeats that enemy).

blade.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent all of that damage. You may exhaust a [[WEAPON]] upgrade you control to gain retaliate 1 until the end of the round.

blade.text: Blade gets +1 DEF. Hero Response: After an enemy enters play, exhaust Predatory Instincts → search your deck and discard pile for a copy of Vampire Bite and add it to your hand.

blade.text: Give to the Eric Brooks player. Uses (3 thirst counters). Forced Interrupt: When your turn begins, remove 1 blood counter from your identity to remove 1 thirst counter from here. If you cannot, take 2 damage.

[[VAMPIRE]] minions get +3 hit points and gain teamwork ([[VAMPIRE]]). Response: After a [[VAMPIRE]] minion is defeated, remove 2 threat from this scheme.

blade.text: Attacks with piercing deal double damage to Vampire. [star] Forced Response: After Vampire attacks and damages a character, heal all damage from Vampire. If no damage was healed this way, give Vampire a tough status card.

blade.text: Attached minion gains the [[VAMPIRE]] trait and gets +X hit points where X is equal to their printed hit points. Attacks with piercing deal double damage to attached minion. When Revealed: Seek a non-[[VAMPIRE]] minion from the encounter deck, reveal it and attach Embraced to it.

skrull_menace.name: * Nick Fury (H'kurrek)
skrull_menace.text: Forced Interrupt: When Nick Fury would leave play, flip him instead. "It was written a wave would come." —Queen Veranke

skrull_menace.name: * H'kurrek
skrull_menace.text: [star] H'kurrek's attacks gain overkill, piercing, and ranged. When Revealed: Heal all damage from H'kurrek and put him into play engaged with you.

skrull_menace.text: Forced Interrupt: When Phoenix would leave play, flip her instead. "You will kill her. After we'll switch you out." —Queen Veranke

skrull_menace.name: * Korya

skrull_menace.name: * Spider-Man (Ch'Gra)
skrull_menace.text: Forced Interrupt: When Spider-Man would leave play, flip him instead. "Well, I do hate myself, but I don't know if I feel like smacking myself around."

skrull_menace.name: * Ch'Gra

skrull_menace.name: Protect the Pantheon
skrull_menace.text: Contents: Kly'bn I and Kly'bn II (Kly'bn II and Kly'bn III instead for expert mode). Skrull Pantheon, Dard'van Sect and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Skrull Society). Setup: Set the Skrull Pantheon environment aside, out of play.

skrull_menace.name: Protect the Pantheon
skrull_menace.text: Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, put the set-aside Skrull Pantheon environment into play, DESTROYED side faceup. Advance to stage 2B. When Completed: Put the set-aside Skrull Pantheon environment into play, STRONGHOLD side faceup. Advance to stage 2A.

skrull_menace.name: Slaying the False Gods
skrull_menace.text: Kly'bn, the Eternal Skrull, and Sl'gur't of the Infinite Names are presented as the emperor and the empress of the Skrull Pantheon. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Strengthen the Faith side scheme, reveal it and place 2[per_hero] additional threat on it.

skrull_menace.name: Slaying the False Gods
skrull_menace.text: Kly'bn and Sl'gur't indirectly supported the creation and expansion of the Skrull Empire. They conquered and enslaved the pantheons of the conquered races, numbering nearly 1000 pantheons. Now the duo is after the gods of Earth. When Revealed: Flip the villain. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

skrull_menace.name: Skrull Pantheon
skrull_menace.text: Hero Action: Spend 2 resources of the same type → remove 1 faith counter from the villain. Kly'bn and Sl'gur't joined together and ascended to godhood becoming the leaders of the Skrull Pantheon.

skrull_menace.name: Skrull Pantheon
skrull_menace.text: Hero Action: Spend 2 resources of any type → remove 1 faith counter from the villain. Skrull Pantheon was successfully destroyed and the Skrull Deity became really angry.

skrull_menace.name: Blessed by Kly'bn
skrull_menace.text:
Attach to the minion with the lowest SCH. If you cannot, this card gains surge. X is equal to the number of faith counters on the villain.
[star] Boost: If this activation is a scheme, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this activation.

skrull_menace.name: Blessed by Sl'gur't
skrull_menace.text:
Attach to the minion with the lowest ATK. If you cannot, this card gains surge. X is equal to the number of faith counters on the villain.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this activation.

skrull_menace.name: * Nogor
skrull_menace.text:
[star] Nogor gets +1 SCH, +1 ATK and +1 hit point for each faith counter on the villain. When Revealed: Flip the villain.
[star] Boost: Flip the villain. "I am the living harness of the power of the gods."

skrull_menace.name: Shapeless Wastes
skrull_menace.text: The Skrullian equivalent of Hell is known as the Shapeless Wastes. Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After an ally or a minion is defeated, if that character has the [[SKRULL]] trait, flip the villain. Otherwise, place 1 faith counter on the villain.

skrull_menace.name: Strengthen the Faith
skrull_menace.text:
Most Skrulls worship Kly'bn, the Eternal Skrull, and Sl'gur't of the Infinite Names. They are the only true gods of the Skrull Empire. Forced Response: After a [[SKRULL]] minion enters play, place 1 faith counter on the villain.
[star] Boost: Place 1 faith counter on the villain.

skrull_menace.name: Prayer to Kly'bn
skrull_menace.text:
When Revealed: If Kly'bn is in play, he activates against you. Otherwise, flip the villain.
[star] Boost: If Kly'bn is not in play, flip the villain. "For I am Kly'bn. I am the Eternal Skrull. And I love you." —Kly'bn

skrull_menace.name: Prayer to Sl'gur't
skrull_menace.text:
When Revealed: If Sl'gur't is in play, she activates against you. Otherwise, flip the villain.
[star] Boost: If Sl'gur't is not in play, flip the villain. "What do they call you? I pray you, tell us..." —Sl'gur't

skrull_menace.name: Talisman of the Skrulls
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Nogor and reveal him. If Nogor did not enter play this way, this card gains surge. "The Talisman is the representation of the gods, and his presence is required to ensure the gods' blessing on our endeavors" —Jazinda

skrull_menace.name: Dard'van Fanatic
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Choose to either deal 1 damage to each character you control or place 1 threat on each scheme in play. "I belong to the Dard'van sect. It's considered extreme by some." —Grrix

skrull_menace.name: Dard'van Priest
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Dard'van Priest schemes. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Dard'van Priest would attack, instead choose a card in play with a "When Revealed" ability and resolve that ability. "He loves you."

skrull_menace.name: Dard'van Sect
skrull_menace.text: A zealous sect of the Skrull Empire which follows prophecies foretelling that Earth will become the new home for the Skrull race. When Revealed: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card.

skrull_menace.name: Collective Prayers
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Discard the top card of the encounter deck for each character in play. Reveal each card discarded this way that belongs to the Dard'van Sect encounter set. "...the first one loves us all alike." —Grrix

skrull_menace.name: Sectarian Practices
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Choose a card in play with a "When Revealed" ability and resolve that ability. If you cannot, this card gains surge. "Trust. What do humans know of trust? You can't even agree on one god." —Nogor

skrull_menace.name: * Shaper of Worlds
skrull_menace.text: Forced Response: After a player attacks Shaper of Worlds, shuffle this card into that player's deck. Forced Interrupt: When Shaper of Worlds enters your hand, discard the top 4 cards of the encounter deck. Put Shaper of Worlds into play engaged with you.

skrull_menace.name: Cosmic Cube Creation
skrull_menace.text: Hinder 4[per_hero]. Victory 2. When Revealed: Put the set-aside Shaper of Worlds into play engaged with you. When Defeated: Each player chooses a copy of the set-aside Cosmic Cube Fragment resource and shuffles it into their deck.

skrull_menace.name: Cosmic Cube Fragment
skrull_menace.text: An artifact to modify reality following the wishes of the user. The Skrulls were the first race to create a Cosmic Cube.

skrull_menace.name: * Crusader
skrull_menace.text: Victory 1. When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each character you control. Give the villain 1 facedown boost card for each character defeated this way. [star] Boost: Put Crusader into play engaged with you.

skrull_menace.name: Enemy Adaptation
skrull_menace.text: Attach to a [[SKRULL]] minion. If you cannot, attach to the villain. You cannot defend against attached enemy's attacks. Hero Action: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card → discard Enemy Adaptation.

skrull_menace.name: * Freedom Ring
skrull_menace.text:
Attach to Crusader. If Crusader is not in play, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded. Put that minion into play engaged with you and attach this card to it. If you cannot, give the villain 1 facedown boost card.
Attached minion gains villainous.

skrull_menace.name: Spy Training
skrull_menace.text: Z'Reg, a Skrull operative who had been scarred by fellow trainee K'rtem, was sent to spy on the Avengers after his training was complete. When Revealed: Defeat an ally you control and give the villain 1 facedown boost card.

skrull_menace.name: Rivals to the End
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Choose a minion. That minion attacks your hero twice in a row. If no attack was made this way, give the villain 1 facedown boost card for each character you control. "Your strategy is pathetic, human! You rush into battle and then you cradle your weak! Ha! Let me show you how Skrulls heed the call!" —K'rtem

skrull_menace.name: * Jazinda
skrull_menace.text: Victory 1. The villain gets +1 SCH. [star] Boost: Put Jazinda into play engaged with you. "Pretending to be human is amusing. Especially when I do it so much better than you."

skrull_menace.name: Skrull Energy Gun
skrull_menace.text: Attach to a [[SKRULL]] minion. If you cannot, attach to the villain. While attached to a [[SKRULL]] enemy, attached enemy's attacks gain overkill, piercing, and ranged. Hero Action: Spend a [physical] resource → attach this card to another enemy.

skrull_menace.name: * Sy-Torak Gem
skrull_menace.text: Attach to Jazinda. If you cannot, attach to the villain. Attached character gets +3 hit points. Hero Action: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card and spend a [energy] resource → discard Sy-Torak Gem.

skrull_menace.name: Stealing for the Empire
skrull_menace.text: A former agent of the Skrull Empire was sent to recover a sacred artifact of the Skrull stolen by the Kree. When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard an attachment. Reveal that attachment. Then, place threat on the main scheme equal to the number of boost icons ([boost]) on that attachment.

skrull_menace.name: Skrull of Royal Blood
skrull_menace.text: Surge. When Revealed: Shuffle all cards with the highest number of boost icons ([boost]) in the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

skrull_menace.name: * Skymax
skrull_menace.text: Victory 1. When Revealed: Shuffle all minions from the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. [star] Boost: Put Skymax into play engaged with you.

skrull_menace.name: Changing Appearance
skrull_menace.text: Attach to a [[SKRULL]] minion. If you cannot, attach to the villain. Attached enemy cannot be attacked. Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would attack, it schemes instead. Then, discard this card. "You're not bad, but my people invented shapeshifting!" —Skymax

skrull_menace.name: Surprising Alliance
skrull_menace.text: "I am my world's last survivor." —Skymax Forced Response: When a player discards an ally from their hand, they put that ally into play engaged with them instead. Treat that ally as a minion with a blank text box. Its SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage.

skrull_menace.name: Shape Alteration
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Remove each stunned and confused status card from each [[SKRULL]] enemy and give each [[SKRULL]] enemy a tough status card. If there are no [[SKRULL]] enemies in play, this card gains surge. [star] Boost: Give 1 [[SKRULL]] enemy a tough status card.

skrull_menace.name: * War Skrull
skrull_menace.text: Victory 1. [star] Forced Response: After War Skrull attacks you, discard the top 2 cards of your deck. [star] Boost: Put War Skrull into play engaged with you.

skrull_menace.name: Impostor
skrull_menace.text: Treat attached ally as a [[SKRULL]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Attach to the non-[[SKRULL]] ally with the most remaining hit points without Impostor attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, the villain schemes.

skrull_menace.name: Skrull Commander
skrull_menace.text: Each other [[SKRULL]] minion gets +1 ATK. [star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, this card gets +2 boost icons ([boost][boost]) for this attack. "If he was a significant threat, we would know who he is" —Commander Ak'strk

skrull_menace.name: Skrull Geneticist
skrull_menace.text: [star] Boost: Deal yourself a facedown encounter card. "These results are fascinating"

skrull_menace.name: Cloning Program
skrull_menace.text: The Skrull scientists had cloned samples of Deadpool's blood and use it to upgrade a squadron of Super-Skrulls. They also place Deadpool in charge of training these new Super-Skrulls. Each [[SKRULL]] minion activates 1 additional time during the step two of the villain phase. Threat cannot be removed from this scheme while there is no [[SKRULL]] minion in play.

skrull_menace.name: * Xavin
skrull_menace.text: Victory 1. When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a treachery is discarded. Reveal that treachery. [star] Boost: Put Xavin into play engaged with you.

skrull_menace.name: Invisible Forcefield
skrull_menace.text: Attach to the enemy with the highest printed hit points and without another Invisible Forcefield attached. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to attached character, place it here instead. Then, if there is at least 5 damage here, discard this card.

skrull_menace.name: Super-Skrull Training Program
skrull_menace.text: "Always remember, when you face a superior opponent, learn their weaknesses. Exploit them. That is the Skrull way." —Commander Chrell When Revealed: Give each [[SKRULL]] enemy a tough status card.

skrull_menace.name: Going Nova
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Assign 2[per_hero] indirect damage among players. "Damnation. I keep forgetting how fragile you people are." —Xavin

skrull_menace.name: Impostor
