When Revealed: Attach to the non-[[SKRULL]] ally with the most remaining hit points without Impostor attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, the villain schemes.

skrull_menace.name: Cursed by the Past
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: If your nemesis minion is in play, it activates against you. Otherwise, find your nemesis minion and reveal it. If your nemesis side scheme is in play, place threat on it equal to its starting threat value. Otherwise, find your nemesis side scheme and reveal it. Shuffle your remaining set-aside nemesis set into the encounter deck.

skrull_menace.name: Experiment Subject
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Discard an upgrade you control. If no card was discarded this way, the villain schemes. "I am curious to see just what the upper limits of his extension are..." —Skrull Scientist

skrull_menace.name: Forge Ahead
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Each minion engaged with you schemes. If no scheme was made this way, the villain schemes. "We are not speaking of conquest. Think of it more as a... strategic protective occupation." —Nogor

skrull_menace.name: Mobilization
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Engage each minion in play. The villain schemes. When Revealed (Hero): The villain and each minion engaged with you attacks you. "We are by any and all definitions, the superior race!" —Dorrek VII

skrull_menace.name: Stick to the Plan
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: The villain attacks the hero with the most remaining hit points. If no attack was made this way, the villain schemes. "Bow down and beg to the Skrulls!" —Paibok

skrull_menace.name: Replaced Archenemy
skrull_menace.text: Attached minion gains the [[SKRULL]] trait. When Revealed: If your nemesis minion is in play, attach this card to it. Then, it activates against you. Otherwise, find your nemesis minion, attach this card to it and reveal it.

skrull_menace.name: Focused Attention
skrull_menace.text: Surge. When Revealed: Give the villain 1 facedown boost card. "Earth shall pay for what it has done to my people!" —Super-Skrull

skrull_menace.name: Tricky Assault
skrull_menace.text: When Revealed: Flip to hero form. The villain attacks you. If this attack is undefended, the villain schemes. "We are prepared to accept your surrender." —Unknown Skrull

skrull_menace.name: * Crusader
skrull_menace.text: Response: After Crusader enters play, choose a player → deal 1 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player. Draw 1 card for each enemy defeated this way.

skrull_menace.name: * Jazinda
skrull_menace.text:
Jazinda does not count against your ally limit.
While Jazinda is exhausted, your hero gets +1 THW.

skrull_menace.name: * Paibok
skrull_menace.text: Toughness. [star] Paibok gets +1 THW and +1 ATK for each treachery card attached to him. Response: After a treachery card is discarded, take 1 damage → attach it facedown here (to a maximum of 2).

skrull_menace.name: * Skymax
skrull_menace.text: Response: When Skymax enters play, shuffle all allies from your discard pile into your deck.

skrull_menace.name: * Super-Skrull

skrull_menace.text: [star] Super-Skrull gets +1 THW and +1 ATK for each different [[SUPERPOWER]] card attached to him. Response: After a [[SUPERPOWER]] card is placed into a discard pile, attach it facedown here (to a maximum of 4).

skrull_menace.name: * Chilly McHotpants
skrull_menace.text: *Treat this ally as a minion engaged with you. [star] Response: After "Chilly McHotpants" attacks you, draw 1 cards. If you take no damage from that attack, draw 1 card.

skrull_menace.name: * Xavin
skrull_menace.text: Interrupt: When Xavin enters play, discard cards from your deck until you discard an event with a "Hero Action" ability. You may resolve that event's "Hero Action" ability.

skrull_menace.name: * Buddy Training Program
skrull_menace.text: Victory 0. X is equal to the villain's stage number. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may give up to X friendly characters a tough status card.

skrull_menace.name: * Cloning Faux Pas
skrull_menace.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may deal up to 3 damage to each [[SKRULL]] minion engaged with them.

skrull_menace.name: * Fickle Alliance
skrull_menace.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may search the encounter deck for a non-[[ELITE]] minion and put it into play under their control. (Shuffle.) Treat that minion as an ally with a blank text box (except for [[TRAITS]]). Its THW is equal to its printed SCH and it takes 1 consequential damage after it thwarts or attacks.

skrull_menace.name: * Newbie Training
skrull_menace.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may defeat a non-[[ELITE]] [[SKRULL]] minion and draw 1 card.

skrull_menace.name: * Searching for Powers
skrull_menace.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may search their deck and discard pile for a card with the [[SUPERPOWER]] trait and play it, ignoring its resource cost. (Shuffle.)

skrull_menace.name: * Skrull Military Training
skrull_menace.text:
Victory 0.
Threat cannot be removed from this scheme unless it is being thwarted by a [[SKRULL]] ally.
While this card is in the victory display, its owner's hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF.

skrull_menace.name: * Stealing For Good
skrull_menace.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme may search their deck and discard pile for an upgrade and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.) Then, they remove threat from a scheme equal to that upgrade's printed cost.

skrull_menace.name: * Antalya
skrull_menace.text: Action: Exhaust Antalya → heal 1 damage from a friendly character.

skrull_menace.name: * Cadre K
skrull_menace.text: Action: Exhaust Cadre K → remove 1 threat from a scheme.

skrull_menace.name: * Pool-O-Vision
skrull_menace.text: Hero Response: After a [[SKRULL]] minion is defeated, exhaust Pool-O-Vision → draw 1 card (to a maximum of 3) for each [crisis], [acceleration], [amplify], and [hazard] in play.

skrull_menace.name: * Princess Anelle
skrull_menace.text: Alliance. X is equal to the total number of players and [[SKRULL]] enemies in play. Response: After the player phase ends, remove Princess Anelle from the game → skip the villain phase.

skrull_menace.name: Skrull Battleship
skrull_menace.text: Play only if you control a [[SKRULL]] ally. Hero Resource: Exhaust Skrull Battleship → generate a [wild] resource for any player.

skrull_menace.name: * Skrull Kill Krew
skrull_menace.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Skrull Kill Krew → deal 1 damage to a [[SKRULL]] minion. If that minion is defeated this way, ready Skrull Kill Krew.

skrull_menace.name: * 3-D Man's Goggles
skrull_menace.text: Attach to a non-[[SKRULL]] ally. Interrupt: When attached ally attacks a [[SKRULL]] enemy, that ally does not take consequential damage.

skrull_menace.name: * Inhibitor Mask
skrull_menace.text:
Attach to a [[SKRULL]] enemy.
Temporary.
Treat attached enemy's printed text box as if it were blank.

skrull_menace.name: * Ultimate Nullifier
skrull_menace.text:
Attach to a [[SKRULL]] enemy.
Temporary.
Attached enemy cannot activate.
While Nullifier is attached to the villain, it gains 1[per_hero] hazard icon ([hazard]).

skrull_menace.name: Reverting Device
skrull_menace.text:
Play under any player's control.
Each [[SKRULL]] minion engaged with you gets -1 SCH.

skrull_menace.name: Skrull Shapeshifter
skrull_menace.text: Play under any player's control. Your identity gains the [[SKRULL]] trait. Interrupt: When you would be defeated, set your hit point dial to 1 instead. Then, discard this card.

skrull_menace.name: * Sy-Torak Gem

galactic_storm.name: Sentry Awakens
galactic_storm.text: Buried deep within an abandoned Kree outpost, the Psyche Magnitron remained dormant—until the vault was breached. Now, Sentry #372 has awakened, programmed to eliminate all intruders and protect its ancient charge at all costs. [star] Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, deal 1 damage to each character for each copy of Sentry's Grasp attached to it.

galactic_storm.name: Self-Destruct Sequence
galactic_storm.text: Realizing the Psyche Magnitron's value, the Kree Sentry redirected all power to its self-destruct sequence. When Revealed: If the Outpost Collapse Protocol side scheme is in play, place 2[per_hero] threat and 1 acceleration token on it. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for the Outpost Collapse Protocol side scheme and reveal it.

galactic_storm.name: Self-Destruct Sequence
galactic_storm.text: [star] Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, deal 1 damage to each character for each copy of Sentry's Grasp attached to it. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

galactic_storm.name: * Rick Jones
galactic_storm.text: The first player controls Rick Jones. He does not count against your ally limit. Forced Interrupt: When Kree Sentry attacks you, it attacks Rick Jones instead. If Rick Jones leaves play, the players lose the game.

galactic_storm.name: Sentry's Grasp
galactic_storm.text: Attached character cannot thwart or scheme and can only attack Kree Sentry or this card. Any player can attack this card as if it were a minion. If there is 3 or more damage here, set Sentry's Grasp aside. Forced Interrupt: When this card would leave play, set it aside instead.

galactic_storm.name: Optic Blast Cannon
galactic_storm.text:
Attach to Kree Sentry. [star] Kree Sentry's attacks gain piercing and ranged. Hero Action: Spend [physical][physical] resources → discard this card.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains piercing and ranged.

galactic_storm.name: Repulsor Blast Unit
galactic_storm.text:
Attach to Kree Sentry. [star] Kree Sentry's attacks gain overkill and ranged. Forced Interrupt: When Sentry's Grasp would be set aside, if there is 5 or more damage on it, discard Repulsor Blast Unit.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains overkill.

galactic_storm.name: Death Grip
galactic_storm.text: Determined to hold the line, his grip tightens with deadly intent. Every move you make only brings his massive hand closer, ready to end the fight in an instant. Sentry's Grasp is set aside when there is 5 or more damage on it instead of 3.

galactic_storm.name: Locking on Target
galactic_storm.text: "A sentry can never surrender. A sentry must be true to its programming." —Kree Sentry Hinder 1[per_hero].

galactic_storm.name: Outpost Collapse Protocol
galactic_storm.text: As the battle rages, the outpost begins to collapse and falling debris threatens everyone inside. Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, the first player deals 1 damage to each character they control.

galactic_storm.name: "Gotcha!"
galactic_storm.text:
When Revealed: Attach a set aside copy of Sentry's Grasp to Rick Jones. If you cannot, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Attach a set aside copy of Sentry's Grasp to Rick Jones. "The sentry is programmed to destroy you — and destroy you I shall!" —Kree Sentry

galactic_storm.name: Caught in Its Sights
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: You may spend 2 resources of any type. If you do not, Kree Sentry attacks Rick Jones. "Prioritizing threat matrix... Targets acquired. Execute primary." —Kree Sentry

galactic_storm.name: Intruder Elimination
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Choose a non-[[KREE]] character. Kree Sentry attacks that character (even if that character is an alter-ego). If an enemy was attacked this way, this card gains surge. "All intruders are to be destroyed!" —Kree Sentry

galactic_storm.name: Disciplined Training
galactic_storm.text: Setup. Each [[IMPERIAL GUARD]] minion gains toughness. Special: Deal 1 damage to your identity. When Revealed: Discard each other [[SETTING]] environment in play.

galactic_storm.name: Loyal Devotion
galactic_storm.text: Setup. Each [[IMPERIAL GUARD]] minion gains teamwork ([[IMPERIAL GUARD]]). Special: Place 1 threat on the main scheme. When Revealed: Discard each other [[SETTING]] environment in play.

galactic_storm.name: Noble Bearing
galactic_storm.text: Setup. Each [[IMPERIAL GUARD]] minion gains guard and the [[ELITE]] trait. Special: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. When Revealed: Discard each other [[SETTING]] environment in play.

galactic_storm.name: * Astra
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard an identity-specific card you control. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "You will cause no more trouble, mutant, once I reach through you intangibly--then materialize my arm ever so slightly-just enough to shock your system to its foundations!"

galactic_storm.name: * Earthquake
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Exhaust your identity. If you were already exhausted, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "I am called Earthquake, mammals...behold the reason why!"

galactic_storm.name: * Electron
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard a [energy] resource from your hand. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "Metal projectiles are useless against Electron, cretins...a man who controls magnetic force!"

galactic_storm.name: * Fang
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard a card you control with a printed [wild] resource. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "In our culture, the warrior title of Fang is won in nigh-mortal combat."

galactic_storm.name: * Gladiator
galactic_storm.text: Victory 0. When Revealed: Defeat a non-scenario specific ally you control. If no ally was defeated this way, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "I would gladly sacrifice your entire galaxy to save the life of a single Shi'ar!"

galactic_storm.name: * Hobgoblin
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Resolve a "When Revealed" ability of another [[IMPERIAL GUARD]] minion in play. If no ability was resolved this way, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "I've a bitter lesson for you, my praetor, things are not always what they seem."

galactic_storm.name: * Hussar
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard an upgrade you control. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "Ah! Another Terran to humble! I forget your name, but that hardly matters."

galactic_storm.name: * Magique
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Give the villain a tough status card. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "My spells will keep them from ensnaring me..."

galactic_storm.name: * Manta
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: You are stunned. If you were already stunned, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "You are to be held until a proper trial is scheduled for you."

galactic_storm.name: * Mentor
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard a player side scheme from play. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "The Imperial Guard will not allow this travesty to proceed any further."

galactic_storm.name: * Neutron
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard a support you control. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "I've a bitter lesson for you, my praetor, things are not always what they seem."

galactic_storm.name: * Nightside
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard a [mental] resource from your hand. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "My name, in your primitive tongue, would be... Nightside. Does that give you a hint what my special power is?"

galactic_storm.name: * Oracle
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: You are confused. If you were already confused, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "If I cannot read your lips, youth...I shall instead read your mind!"

galactic_storm.name: * Pulsar
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard a [physical] resource from your hand. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "I will kill you extremely slowly for your insolence!"

galactic_storm.name: * Smasher
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard an event from your hand. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "I am recalling you to serve, Superguardian." —Gladiator

galactic_storm.name: * Starbolt
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Remove 1 all-purpose counter from a card you control. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "My body was converted to energy. Its physical weaknesses, its... attributes... are no more."

galactic_storm.name: * Titan
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard a resource card from your hand. If you cannot, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "Let's see you survive a foot-stomp, little mammal!"

galactic_storm.name: * Warstar
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an [[IMPERIAL GUARD]] minion, reveal it. Otherwise, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[SETTING]] environment. "Do not struggle, Terran. It merely forces us to increase the force of our grip."

galactic_storm.name: Guard Assembles
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard an [[IMPERIAL GUARD]] minion and reveal it. "I am recalling you to serve, Superguardian. Ready your family and report to the flagship, Lilandra. I will be waiting for you there." —Gladiator

galactic_storm.name: Imperial Formation
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Resolve the "When Revealed" ability of each [[IMPERIAL GUARD]] minion in play. If you cannot, search the encounter deck and discard pile for an [[IMPERIAL GUARD]] minion and reveal it. "You are here to answer for your crimes." —Gladiator

galactic_storm.name: Kree Leader
galactic_storm.text: The villain cannot be affected by player cards. Attachments attached to the villain cannot be discarded. [star] Forced Interrupt: When the villain would attack you, deal yourself a facedown encounter card instead. "Hidden on Hala, the Kree leader arms to face heroes."

galactic_storm.name: Tanalth
galactic_storm.text: [star] Forced Response: After Tanalth attacks and defeats a character, give her a tough status card. If she already has a tough status card, give her a facedown boost card. "I have prey, then I hunt it, and kill or capture. For I am Tanalth, Grand-High Pursuer of the Kree."

galactic_storm.name: Kree Leader
galactic_storm.text: The villain cannot be affected by player cards. Attachments attached to the villain cannot be discarded. [star] Forced Interrupt: When the villain would attack you, deal yourself a facedown encounter card instead. "Hidden on Hala, the Kree leader arms to face heroes."

galactic_storm.name: Tanalth
galactic_storm.text: [star] Forced Response: After Tanalth attacks and defeats a character, give her a tough status card. If she already has a tough status card, give her a facedown boost card. "In a shocking revelation, the Kree leader Tanalth proved to be none other than the Skrull Empress R'KIII."

galactic_storm.name: Kree Leader
galactic_storm.text: The villain cannot be affected by player cards. Attachments attached to the villain cannot be discarded. [star] Forced Interrupt: When the villain would attack you, deal yourself a facedown encounter card instead. "Hidden on Hala, the Kree leader arms to face heroes."

galactic_storm.name: Tanalth
galactic_storm.text: Steady. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for Grand-High Pursuer and attach it to Tanalth. [star] Forced Response: After Tanalth attacks and defeats a character, give her a tough status card and a facedown boost card.

galactic_storm.name: Hidden Might of Hala
galactic_storm.text: Contents: Kree Leader (I) and Kree Leader (II) (Kree Leader (II) and Kree Leader (III) instead for expert mode). Hala Ultimatum and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Accuser Corps). Setup: Put the Hala environment into play. Each player searches the encounter deck for a KREE minion and reveals it.

galactic_storm.name: Hidden Might of Hala
galactic_storm.text: Heroes traveled to the Kree homeworld to stop their conquest and expansion. Forced Interrupt: When a minion is defeated, remove 1 hideout counter from Hala. Forced Response: After the last hideout counter is removed from Hala, advance to stage 2A. If this scheme is completed, the players lose the game.

galactic_storm.name: Reckoning Begins
galactic_storm.text: From the depths of Hala to the front lines, Tanalth and her elite Kree legions advance, signaling the Empire's wrath. When Revealed: Flip the villain to its DISCOVERED side and set the Hala environment aside. Each player draws 1 card.

galactic_storm.name: Reckoning Begins
galactic_storm.text: The air trembles as Tanalth appears, her voice carrying orders that stir the Kree army into relentless action. If this scheme is completed, the players lose the game.

galactic_storm.name: * Hala
galactic_storm.text: Enters play with 2 hideout counters, plus 2[per_hero] additional hideout counters. Scour the Planet — Action: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a KREE minion and reveal it → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round per player.)

galactic_storm.name: * Grand-High Pursuer
galactic_storm.text:
Attach to the villain. Attached villain gains retaliate 1. Hero Action: Spend [energy][mental][physical] resources → discard this card.
[star] Boost: If the activating enemy has a tough status card, give it an additional boost card.

galactic_storm.name: Kree Plasma Rifle
galactic_storm.text: Attach to the villain. [star] Attached villain's attacks gain piercing and ranged. Hero Action: Spend [energy][mental][physical] resources → discard this card. "I would have given you all quick deaths. As painless as possible! Not anymore..." —Tanalth

galactic_storm.name: Kree Resilience
galactic_storm.text:
Attach to the villain. Attached villain can have 1 additional tough status card. Hero Action: Spend [physical][physical] resources → discard this card.
[star] Boost: Give the activating enemy a tough status card. "To the last Kree!" —Tanalth

galactic_storm.name: Kree Assassin
galactic_storm.text:
Retaliate 1.
[star] Boost: If the activating enemy has a tough status card, exhaust your identity. "All we await now is our target." —Sals-Bek

galactic_storm.name: Kree Pursuer
galactic_storm.text: Patrol. Quickstrike. When Defeated: If the villain has a tough status card, shuffle Kree Pursuer into the encounter deck. "Get out of the way!"

galactic_storm.name: Kree Soldier
galactic_storm.text:
Guard.
[star] Boost: If the activating enemy has a tough status card, put Kree Soldier into play engaged with you. "The Kree army protects its own..."

galactic_storm.name: House of Fiyero
galactic_storm.text: A powerful Kree guild, using its wealth and influence to pursue its ambitions. Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Remove 1 hideout counter from Hala. If you cannot, the defeating player may discard an attachment with the text "Hero Action" from an enemy.

galactic_storm.name: Mobilizing the Empire
galactic_storm.text: The Kree are an extremely militaristic and disciplined race, bred for war, conquest, and absolute loyalty to their empire. Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Remove 1 hideout counter from Hala. If you cannot, the defeating player may draw 1 card.

galactic_storm.name: Secrets of Detention Core
galactic_storm.text: Every prisoner of Hala serves the Kree Empire one way or another. Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Remove 1 hideout counter from Hala. If you cannot, the defeating player may ready a character they control.

galactic_storm.name: Advanced Arsenal
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Give the villain a tough status card. If the villain already has a tough status card, discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard an attachment or a minion and reveal it.

galactic_storm.name: Battle Cry
galactic_storm.text:
When Revealed: Give the villain a tough status card. If the villain already has a tough status card, give it a facedown boost card.
[star] Boost: If the activating enemy has a tough status card, this card gets +2 boost icons for this activation.

galactic_storm.name: Bloodthirst of Hala
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Give the villain a tough status card. If the villain already has a tough status card, the villain activates against you. "No quarter! Remember you are Kree!" —Ronan

galactic_storm.name: * The Accused
galactic_storm.text:
Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When an enemy initiates an attack against the attached identity, that enemy gets +1 ATK for that attack. Forced Response: After an ACCUSER CORPS enemy is defeated, discard this card.
[star] Boost: Attach to your identity.

galactic_storm.name: Universal Weapon
galactic_storm.text:
Attach to the villain. Attached character gains steady and the ACCUSER CORPS trait. Hero Action: Take 2 damage and deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card → shuffle this card into the encounter deck.
[star] Boost: Attach to an enemy.

galactic_storm.name: Unwavering
galactic_storm.text: Attach to an enemy. [star] Forced Response: After attached enemy attacks and damages a character, discard this card. [star] Boost: Attach to an enemy. "I have passed judgment, nothing more, nothing less. It is justice...that has been done." —Ronan

galactic_storm.name: Kree Accuser
galactic_storm.text: Toughness. Villainous. "Will you need me to employ physical force?" —Lauri-Ell

galactic_storm.name: Judgement Day
galactic_storm.text: When Revealed: Each ACCUSER CORPS enemy activates against you. If no enemy activated this way, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Kree Accuser and reveal it. "Accusers... restrain the prisoners!" —Ronan
